infotexts.afflictiondescription.deep_calm_buff: After taking painkillers, you feel less sensitive to pain. ‖color:gui.blue‖(While active: Aiming with injured arms will not sway, injured legs will not reduce movement speed)‖end‖
infotexts.afflictiondescription.deep_upgrade_tool_: This gun has been precision-modified to fully unleash its firepower characteristics. ‖color:gui.blue‖(Deal an additional 30% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.afflictiondescription.deep_temporary_rei: This character is a temporary crewmember. Do not leave your items on them, as they will leave when the time is up.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.deep_contract_blit: 12-minute combat timer, counting from 0 to 12. You must start the next round before the 12-minute mark, or the current round will restart.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.deep_bullet_injury: The bullet didn't penetrate the armor but caused blunt trauma. A significant bruise is visible at the impact point. (Torso Cap: 40, This damage heals over time) (Treat with Deep Diving Medkit or Surgical Kit)

The bullet didn't penetrate the arm armor but caused blunt trauma. A significant bruise is visible at the impact point. (Limb Cap: 10, This damage heals over time) (Treat with Deep Diving Medkit or Surgical Kit)

The bullet didn't penetrate the groin armor but caused blunt trauma. A significant bruise is visible at the impact point. (Limb Cap: 10, This damage heals over time) (Treat with Deep Diving Medkit or Surgical Kit)

The bullet didn't penetrate the armor but caused blunt trauma. A significant bruise is visible at the impact point. (Torso Cap: 40, This damage heals over time) (Treat with Deep Diving Medkit or Surgical Kit)
The bullet didn't penetrate the helmet but caused blunt trauma. Feeling a bit dizzy. (Head Cap: 70, This damage heals over time) (Treat with Deep Diving Medkit or Surgical Kit)
infotexts.afflictiondescription.Shrapnel_residue: Shrapnel is lodged in your body. A medical kit is needed to remove the fragments. (Lethal damage type, This damage heals over time) (Treat with Deep Diving Medkit or Surgical Kit)
infotexts.afflictiondescription.hollow_point: A bullet is lodged in your body. A medical kit is needed to remove the slug.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.m18_smoke: Smoke provides cover for your retreat (Gain 50% Headshot Resistance, +25% Spread).
infotexts.afflictiondescription.armor_ceramics: Ceramic plate is intact. Character takes no damage until it breaks.
infotexts.afflictioncauseofdeathself.hollow_point: You died from a hollow-point bullet.
infotexts.afflictioncauseofdeath.deep_headshot_dea: The bullet pierced the brain. Only death awaits.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.hollow_point.low: The bullet missed vital organs, but the risk of pain and infection remains.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.deep_headshot_dead: The bullet missed the head, but maybe the next one won't be so lucky. (Cap: 20, Does not cause death when full, This damage heals over time) (Treat with Combat Medical Kit)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_general_fabricato: The universal fabricator for Deep Diving Armory. All DDA items are crafted here. It has a built-in small reactor, so no wiring is needed. (Install with Right Mouse Button + E)
infotexts.entitydescription.gold_mineral: ‖color:gui.red‖(Spawns in the abyss of Aphotic Plateau, The Abyss, Hydrothermal Wastes)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Refine in Ore Refinery)‖end‖ Extremely rare gold ore containing small amounts of precious gold, used to make Solid State Drives (SSD).
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_tungsten_ore: ‖color:gui.red‖(Spawns in the abyss of Aphotic Plateau, The Abyss, Hydrothermal Wastes)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Refine in Ore Refinery)‖end‖ Tungsten ore found only in the abyss, used to craft the most penetrating ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_tungsten: Tungsten is used to make penetrating bullets. For this reason, Tungsten has become the most crucial strategic resource on Europa. Both the Coalition and the Separatists are vying for control over Tungsten ore deposits. ‖color:gui.red‖(Refine Tungsten Ore in Ore Refinery)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_tungsten_phy: ‖color:gui.red‖(Mine Tungsten Ore in the abyss of Aphotic Plateau, The Abyss, Hydrothermal Wastes)‖end‖ A combination of refined Tungsten and Physicorium rods. The discovery of Tungsten Physicorium marked a turning point in Europan material science, boasting exceptional quality and hardness exceeding diamond.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_gold: ‖color:gui.red‖(Mine Gold Ore in the abyss of Aphotic Plateau, The Abyss, Hydrothermal Wastes)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.yellow‖Purified gold, can be used to craft Solid State Drives (SSD) or Gold Bars.‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_hk416: An assault rifle chambered in 5.56x45mm. Features a two-part polymer forend and a free-floating barrel, offering low recoil and good heat resistance. Includes repair tools, striking an excellent balance between performance and utility. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, Burst)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.6s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 850 RPM) (Can repair electrical and mechanical devices)

infotexts.entitydescription.steel_barrel: Steel barrel used for crafting basic weapons.
infotexts.entitydescription.steel_part: A box filled with steel firearm parts, including springs, triggers, sights, etc.
infotexts.entitydescription.holographic_sight: Holographic sight providing 1x magnification (-30% Spread, +20% Movement Speed, +15% Damage, +15 Weapon Handling).
infotexts.entitydescription.2x_sight: Provides 2x magnification, allowing the shooter to more easily hit vital spots (-40% Spread, +10 Weapon Handling, +10% Damage, +15% Movement Speed). ‖color:gui.red‖(Requires Lua: Provides minor range bonus when aiming down sights (RMB))‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.2.5x_sight: 2.5x sight greatly enhances weapon accuracy, allowing the shooter to hit vital spots more precisely (-60% Spread, +20 Weapon Handling, +5% Damage, +10% Movement Speed). ‖color:gui.red‖(Requires Lua: Provides medium range bonus when aiming down sights (RMB))‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.3x_sight: 1-6x "Vudu" sight, highly praised among marksmen. (-80% Spread, +30 Weapon Handling, -25% Movement Speed) ‖color:gui.red‖(Requires Lua: Provides significant range bonus when aiming down sights (RMB))‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Use Mouse Wheel to zoom)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.red_sight: 1x red dot sight, ideal for indoor assaults (-15% Spread, +30% Movement Speed, +20% Damage, +20 Weapon Handling).
infotexts.entitydescription.chemicalreactionchambe: Reaction chamber used for crafting chemicals (Install with Right Mouse Button + E).
infotexts.entitydescription.saltpeter_powder: White crystalline powder used for making gunpowder.
infotexts.entitydescription.sulfur_powder: Yellow crystalline powder with a foul smell, used for making gunpowder.
infotexts.entitydescription.saltpeter_mineral: White crystalline chunks, can be crushed to make gunpowder.
infotexts.entitydescription.sulfur_mineral: Yellow crystalline chunks, can be crushed to make gunpowder.
infotexts.entitydescription.gun_powder: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Basic gunpowder, used for crafting conventional ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.tungsten_phy_barrel: A combination of alien materials and Tungsten Physicorium, used for crafting the finest weapons.
infotexts.entitydescription.tungsten_phy_part: A combination of alien materials and Tungsten Physicorium, used for crafting the finest weapons.
infotexts.entitydescription.titaniumaluminiumalloy: Titanium barrel, used for crafting high-end weapons.
infotexts.entitydescription.physicorium_barrel: A barrel incorporating alien materials, far surpassing existing human materials in heat resistance, corrosion resistance, and mechanical strength.
infotexts.entitydescription.titaniumaluminiumalloy: Precious titanium firearm parts, used for crafting high-end weapons.
infotexts.entitydescription.physicorium_part: Extremely rare Physicorium firearm parts. Components made from alien materials exhibit superior performance.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sg556: The SG556 uses 5.56x45 ammunition, featuring high damage and accuracy. However, its longer barrel makes it passive in close-quarters combat and prone to overheating. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, Burst)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 100) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 6, Damage Multiplier: 1.2, Rate of Fire: 690 RPM, -10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_aug: The AUG assault rifle features a bullpup design, firing 5.56x45mm rounds. It boasts advantages like light weight, ease of maintenance, and portability, making it highly popular among security officers. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 100) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 6, Damage Multiplier: 1.0, Rate of Fire: 750 RPM, +5% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_c7a1: This extra-long assault rifle from Earth fires 5.56x45mm rounds. Its heavy frame grants the shooter high accuracy, combined with an 800 RPM rate of fire, giving this rifle a significant advantage in combat. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 110) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1.1, Rate of Fire: 800 RPM, -20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_C8-SFW: A carbine using 5.56x45mm ammunition with a very high rate of fire. It utilizes a special 400mm heavy barrel and an improved chamber design, enhancing accuracy, durability, and barrel life. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 110) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.8s, Spread: 6, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 850 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_FAMAS: This rifle uses a special 5.56x45mm straight-insertion magazine. It features high rate of fire, high mobility, and resistance to overheating, although the recoil is a bit high. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, Burst)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 100) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 1.0, Rate of Fire: 920 RPM, +5% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_EF88: A bullpup rifle chambered in 5.56x45. Among bullpup assault rifles, it has relatively high damage and good accuracy. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 110) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 1.0, Rate of Fire: 780 RPM, +5% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_G36C: An assault rifle chambered in 5.56x45. Its short frame is very suitable for CQC, offering excellent mobility. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 110) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.8s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 780 RPM, +10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_HK33: An exquisite assault rifle, based on the roller-delayed blowback action of the G3 rifle series, scaled down for 5.56x45 ammunition. Comes with a 30-round magazine. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.8s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 750 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_L85A2: Successor to the L85A1 rifle, using 5.56x45 ammunition. Reliability has been significantly improved, achieving a balance in performance. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 110) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 670 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m4: A modified rifle using 5.56x45 ammunition, equipped with a 317.5mm barrel and a 6-position adjustable stock. A common weapon among arms dealers. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, Burst)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 100) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 7, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 800 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_SCAR-H: An exquisite battle rifle using 7.62x51 ammunition. It employs a short-stroke gas piston operating system, resulting in high accuracy, high damage, and significant stopping power. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 130) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2.2s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 600 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_g3a3: Most parts of the G3 are stamped, with few machined components. The receiver is stamped, with grooves pressed on both sides to guide the bolt and secure the buttstock assembly. The G3 barrel uses conventional rifling, and 12 longitudinal grooves are cut into the chamber wall from the mouth to 6.4mm from the breech face to reduce extraction resistance. The G3 is an automatic rifle using the roller-delayed blowback principle, firing the 7.62x51 full-power cartridge. Although the recoil is high, its power is undeniable. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 110) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Texture provided by: Shadow Moon Azure Wolf)‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 10, Damage Multiplier: 1.1, Rate of Fire: 600 RPM)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_762x51_M61: Contains 20 rounds of 7.62x51mm M80A1 ammunition. Easily penetrates armor and is highly praised by Coalition special forces. (Armor Penetration: 0.85) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 8‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 2)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Fulgurium Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_762x51_M993: Contains 20 rounds of 7.62x51mm M993 ammunition. As the top-tier bullet for full-power rifles, its power and penetration are undeniable. infotexts.entitydescription.wuchuan_design: An extremely rare Wuchuan blueprint, allowing the crafting of its prototype weapon.
infotexts.entitydescription.glassfibre: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Fiberglass, an inorganic non-metallic material with excellent properties: good insulation, high heat resistance, good corrosion resistance, high mechanical strength. Commonly used as a base material for weapon bodies. (Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_epoxy_resin: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Epoxy resin is a material with strong water resistance and good electrical insulation. It can be used as an adhesive for ballistic materials and plate covers, and also in the manufacture of carbon fiber and reinforced fiberglass. (Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_polyurethane: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Polyurethane adhesive is renowned in the field of high-end equipment manufacturing for its excellent chemical bonding properties. It has become the adhesive for high-end ceramic plates and composite plates on Europa. (Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)
infotexts.entitydescription.engineeringplastic: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Expensive plastic produced through a series of complex reactions. Excellent corrosion resistance, very suitable for long-term immersion in Europa's underwater environment. (Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK47: An ancient weapon from Earth. For some reason, you instinctively use a special firing technique, as if it's ingrained in your bones. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 8, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 600 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK47_gold: An AK made of real gold. Gold should be used for necessities, not aesthetics. "A firearm crafted from resources plundered by the Pirate King. He always kept this gun by his side, even while sleeping." ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 6, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 650 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK81: The Type 81-1 assault rifle uses 7.62x39mm ammunition. It features good accuracy, reliable action, simple operation and maintenance, and performs well in combat. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 7, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 600 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_qbz_95: The Type 95 assault rifle uses 5.8x42mm ammunition. Its bullpup design is suitable for combat in narrow spaces. infotexts.entitydescription.deep_qbz_95_1: The Type 95-1 assault rifle uses 5.8x42mm ammunition. It is an improved version of the Type 95, aimed at optimizing ergonomics. Improvements include: removal of the front grip, improved safety selector position, and improved ejection port. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 130) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 700 RPM, +5% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_qbz_97: The Type 97 assault rifle is based on the Type 95. It uses 5.56mm ammunition and STANAG magazines, and features Picatinny rails for easy sight installation. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 130) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1.3, Rate of Fire: 700 RPM, +5% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_qbz_03: The Type 03 assault rifle uses 5.8x42mm ammunition. The perfect combination of traditional layout and folding structure allows it to maintain portability while offering a more comfortable shooting experience and stable aiming performance. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 130) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1.2, Rate of Fire: 700 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_qbz_191: The QBZ-191 assault rifle uses 5.8x42mm ammunition. It features an upper and lower receiver design, combining an aluminum alloy upper receiver with a high-strength composite lower receiver, weighing only 3.4kg. "Modularity + Ergonomics + Reliability" trinity, optimized for rapid precision fire in open battlefields. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Stable Shooting: Aiming with injured arms will not sway)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 1, Damage Multiplier: 1.1, Rate of Fire: 750 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_qbz_192: Modified based on the QBZ-191 assault rifle, using 5.8x42mm ammunition and a shorter barrel. The overall weight is lighter than the 191. Optimized for indoor CQB rapid precision fire. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Stable Shooting: Aiming with injured arms will not sway)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 750 RPM, +15% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK74: The story of the AK-74 automatic rifle actually began in the mid-1960s on Earth. An AK firearm using 5.45x39mm, cheap to produce, durable. This rifle still serves on Europa today. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 650 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK101: Developed from the AK-74M, the AK-101 uses 5.56x45mm ammunition. The AK-101 is essentially an AK-74M chambered for the standard NATO 5.56mm round. Externally identical, except the receiver is marked in English with the caliber "CAL 5.56 NATO". ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 1.3, Rate of Fire: 650 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK103: Similar to the AK-74M, the AK-103 incorporates modern composite engineering plastics, features a 415mm (16-inch) barrel, and an AK-74 style muzzle brake. Can be fitted with scopes and grenade launchers. Fires 7.62x39mm ammunition, equipped with a black plastic 30-round magazine and a plastic folding stock. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 130) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 6, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 600 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK201: The AK-201 is an improved version of the AK-101 assault rifle, designed to enhance performance and adaptability. Uses 5.56x45mm NATO ammunition. The adjustments involve materials, manufacturing processes, and some design modifications to increase reliability and efficiency on the battlefield. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 130) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1.3, Rate of Fire: 650 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK15: The AK-15 uses 7.62x39mm ammunition and replaces the fixed-length stock with a folding, adjustable stock, suitable for soldiers of different builds or those wearing body armor. Additionally, the AK-15 uses Picatinny rails, allowing various attachments like optical sights, flashlights, and laser pointers to be mounted above and below the barrel. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 1.1, Rate of Fire: 700 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK19: The AK-19 was developed based on the 5.45mm caliber AK-12 assault rifle. This individual weapon uses standard NATO 5.56mm ammunition. This rifle is Kalashnikov's latest export model. Differing from previous generations, this model is more ergonomic, suitable for all-day use, and offers higher accuracy. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1.3, Rate of Fire: 700 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AK205: The AK-205 is a carbine using 5.45x39mm ammunition, a modernized version of the AK-105. Features a shorter barrel, making it more suitable for indoor CQB. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1.1, Rate of Fire: 700 RPM, +15 Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_pmm: The PMM is small and lightweight, typically carried by officers of mid-rank and above, hence also known as the "Officer's Pistol". It uses a simple blowback operation, is structurally simple, reliable, and low-cost, favored by officers. However, it has a fatal flaw: low penetration depth. ‖color:gui.red‖(When holding a pistol with health below 50%, triggers Mozambique Drill: +50% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 1s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1)
infotexts.entitydescription.groundglass: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Glass primarily refined from silicon, used for crafting various sights. (Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_9mmp: Contains 8 rounds of 9x18mm pistol ammunition, low penetration power. (Armor Penetration: 0.15) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 1‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 2)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Lead Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.ammoreload_machine: Deep Diving Armory Universal Ammo Loader
infotexts.entitydescription.ammoreload_machine: Fully automatic ammo loader, used for pressing ammunition. Logistics can finally enjoy some downtime.
infotexts.entityname.deep_plate_repairtable: Deep Diving Armory Plate Repair Station
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_repairtable: A plate repair station developed by Deep Diving Armory, used for repairing damaged ceramic and composite plates. "Buy Deep Diving plates now and get 25% off! Plus a free plate repair station!"
infotexts.entitydescription.ammoreload: Fully automatic ammo loader, suitable for lead rifle rounds. Logistics can finally enjoy some downtime.
infotexts.entitydescription.ammobox1: Lead ammunition box, can reload 64 lead rifle magazines, 96 lead SMG magazines, 128 lead pistol magazines, 32 lead drum magazines, 16 lead LMG boxes, 8 lead GPMG boxes. (Suitable for lead ammunition)
infotexts.entitydescription.vertical_grip: The vertical grip allows the shooter to hold the firearm more firmly, improving weapon handling (-30% Stun, -100% Water Flow Effect, +5 Weapon Handling, -10% Movement Speed).
infotexts.entitydescription.vertical_grips_short: A lightweight and compact short grip, enhancing the user's grip and control over the firearm (-20% Stun, -50% Water Flow Effect, +10 Weapon Handling).
infotexts.entitydescription.vertical_grips_hollow_: Metal hollowed-out grip, very suitable for beginners learning how to shoot (-10% Stun, +100% Weapon Handling Skill Gain Speed, +30% Experience Gained).
infotexts.entitydescription.cqr_grips: The CQR tactical grip is the top choice for indoor combat, providing a comfortable grip position for the shooter (During indoor combat: -20% Stun, +10% Movement Speed, +10 Weapon Handling).
infotexts.entitydescription.oblique_grips: The angled grip helps you maintain a firm grip on the firearm during reloads and perform tactical retreats (During reload: +20% Movement Speed, 50% Stun Resistance).
infotexts.entitydescription.corner_grip: The corner grip provides a more comfortable shooting stance (+15% Movement Speed, +25 Weapon Handling).
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sub_hanging_maste:
An underbarrel shotgun mounted on the bottom rail of a firearm. The shooter can switch between shotgun and standard ammunition firing modes, allowing for flexible tactical choices.
‖color:gui.red‖(Occupies bottom rail slot, press F to switch firing mode)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(-20% Movement Speed, -20 Weapon Handling)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sub_hanging_m203:
Suitable for NATO series firearms. A grenade launcher mounted on the bottom rail. The shooter can switch to fire grenades, perfect for dealing with swarms of enemies.
‖color:gui.red‖(Occupies bottom rail slot, press F to switch firing mode)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Range 10m, -20% Movement Speed, -20 Weapon Handling)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sub_hanging_gp25:
Suitable for AK series firearms. A grenade launcher mounted on the bottom rail, capable of firing 40mm grenades.
‖color:gui.red‖(Occupies bottom rail slot, press F to switch firing mode)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Range 10m, -20% Movement Speed, -20 Weapon Handling)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sub_hanging_qlg10:
Also known as the Type 10 Underbarrel Grenade Launcher. Suitable for 5.8x42mm caliber firearms, capable of firing 35mm grenades.
‖color:gui.red‖(Occupies bottom rail slot, press F to switch firing mode)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Range 12m, -20% Movement Speed, -20 Weapon Handling)‖end‖

infotexts.entitydescription.focusingflashlight_p: A small flashlight suitable for pistols. Illuminates further and brighter than a standard flashlight. Built-in nuclear battery, so no recharging required.
infotexts.entitydescription.spreadflashlight_p: A small wide-beam flashlight can illuminate the deep oceans of Europa. Built-in nuclear battery, so no recharging required.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_laser: Tactical equipment that emits a red laser, improving the shooter's handling feel at close range and helping to quickly redirect the muzzle away from teammates. ‖color:gui.red‖(Change mount position by holding in hand)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Effects of the same type do not stack)‖end‖ (-10% Spread, +10 Weapon Handling) (-50% Damage dealt to friendly targets)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_laser_R: Tactical equipment that emits a red laser, improving the shooter's handling feel at close range and helping to quickly redirect the muzzle away from teammates. ‖color:gui.red‖(Change mount position by holding in hand)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Effects of the same type do not stack)‖end‖ (-10% Spread, +10 Weapon Handling) (-50% Damage dealt to friendly targets)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_M1911: The M1911 uses .45 ACP bullets. This pistol employs a short recoil operation principle. Its 11.43mm large caliber ammunition delivers significant stopping power. It is reliable, durable, and easy to maintain. ‖color:gui.red‖(When holding a pistol with health below 50%, triggers Mozambique Drill: +50% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 1s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_M45meusoc: Developed from the M1911, the M45 is an air-cooled, magazine-fed, short recoil-operated, single-action semi-automatic pistol chambered in .45 ACP. This model is the Marine Corps special issue version, your reliable sidearm. ‖color:gui.red‖(When holding a pistol with health below 50%, triggers Mozambique Drill: +50% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 1s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1.5)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_.45acpmag: Contains 7 rounds of 11.43mm pistol ammunition. Sacrifices penetration for higher stopping power. (Armor Penetration: 0.1) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 1‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 2)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Lead Reloading Box.)‖end‖

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_FN57: The FN57 uses 5.7x28mm ammunition, offering excellent penetration. Within effective range, it can penetrate standard body armor, whereas a 9mm pistol round cannot even at 10m. ‖color:gui.red‖(When holding a pistol with health below 50%, triggers Mozambique Drill: +50% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 1s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_fn57_mute: The FN57 FDE is an improved model of the FN57, using 5.7x28mm ammunition. Easily penetrates armor and comes with an integrated suppressor, focusing more on stealth operations. ‖color:gui.red‖(When holding a pistol with health below 50%, triggers Mozambique Drill: +50% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Stealth Shot while crouching: +20% Lethal Headshot damage, +10% Gunshot Wound)‖end‖ (-80% Noise Range, -20% Spread) (Reload: 1s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1.5)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_glock17: The Glock 17 is a 9mm caliber pistol. It extensively uses plastic parts, significantly reducing weight. Uses 9x19mm pistol ammunition, well-balanced performance. ‖color:gui.red‖(When holding a pistol with health below 50%, triggers Mozambique Drill: +50% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 1s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_glock18c: The Glock 18C is an improved model of the Glock 17, using 9x19mm ammunition. Features a full-auto mode, providing significantly more firepower. Its extremely high rate of fire can empty the magazine in an instant. Using an extended magazine is recommended. ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Full Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1000 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_18c_buttstock: A stock modification for the Glock 18C, reducing the recoil of the automatic pistol to some extent. (+10 Weapon Handling, -20% Spread, -10% Movement Speed)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_deserteagle: The Desert Eagle pistol uses .50AE ammunition. It employs a gas-operated mechanism and a rotating bolt locking system. It is a high-power hunting pistol adaptable with different caliber barrels to fire various caliber rounds. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.4, -20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_whiteeagle: An exquisite white Desert Eagle, once the sidearm of a legendary captain. Uses a special receiver to greatly increase the rate of fire. In the hands of an experienced old captain, its full potential can be unleashed. The aiming ring uses alien relics to enhance the user's reaction speed; side effects are unknown. Raising this big iron activates "Deadeye", enemies will be turned to dust in an instant. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Full Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 12, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.15, -20% Movement Speed) (Deadeye charges for 1.5s, slows nearby creatures' movement speed, increases own rate of fire and damage resistance when active)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_.50aemag: Contains 7 rounds of .50AE pistol ammunition, capable of turning carbon-based lifeforms into pulp. (Armor Penetration: 0.5) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 5)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 5‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 10)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖

infotexts.entitydescription.ammoreload_7.62: Fully automatic ammo loader, suitable for large caliber rifle rounds. One of the joys of logistics.
infotexts.entitydescription.ammoreload_12.7: Fully automatic ammo loader, suitable for extra-large caliber rifle rounds. Logistics ecstasy.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_c1: The C1 SMG's receiver and barrel shroud are integral. The shroud has many cooling holes. It uses a left-side feeding curved magazine and a folding stock. Overall performance is acceptable, its only fatal flaw is the low rate of fire. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1.1, Rate of Fire: 550 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_thompson: The Thompson Submachine Gun M1921 features a stock and foregrip. Empty weight 4.9 kg, total length approx. 860 mm. Fires .45 inch (11.43 mm) Colt automatic pistol rounds, max rate of fire 800 RPM. Feed system options include a 20-round standard magazine or a 50-round large drum designed for SMGs. Also known as the "Chicago Typewriter". Equipped with a large drum magazine, the Thompson can unleash its full potential. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 7, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 750 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
