infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_9mm_du: Contains 30 rounds of 9mm DU ammo. Can penetrate friendly targets to damage enemies. (Armor Penetration: 0.5) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 5)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 5‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can penetrate friendly targets, cannot deal damage to friendlies)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Hit creatures suffer -30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 1)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Depleted Uranium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_9mm_phy: Contains 30 rounds of 9mm Physicorium ammo, possessing high armor penetration value. (Armor Penetration: 0.6) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 6‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 1)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_9mm_fu: Contains 30 rounds of 9mm Fulgurium Physicorium ammo, possessing a high penetration level. (Armor Penetration: 0.7) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 7)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 7‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 1)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Fulgurium Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_9mm_ap: Contains 30 rounds of 9mm Tungsten Physicorium ammo. The culmination of the Coalition Armory's R&D division's efforts, this ammunition boasts a level 8 penetration rating. (Armor Penetration: 0.8, Can penetrate doors and walls) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 8‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 1)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Tungsten Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_tom: Contains 50 rounds of 11.43mm Colt automatic pistol ammo, for the Chicago Typewriter. (Armor Penetration: 0.3) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 3‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Leg Damage: +65%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 3)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Lead Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_vector: Contains 30 rounds of .45 ACP ammo, suitable for the Vector SMG. (Armor Penetration: 0.4) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 4‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Leg Damage: +65%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 3)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Titanium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_vector_du: Contains 30 rounds of .45 ACP ammo. Can penetrate friendlies to damage enemies. (Armor Penetration: 0.4) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 4‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can penetrate friendly targets, cannot deal damage to friendlies)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Targets hit suffer -30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Leg Damage: +65%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 3)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Depleted Uranium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_vector_rip: Contains 30 rounds of .45 ACP RIP ammo. The RIP bullet's tip is pre-fragmented. Although it has low armor penetration, this is exchanged for a higher cavitation effect. (Armor Penetration: 0.1) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 1‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Leg Damage: +120%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 6)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Copper Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_vector: The Vector SMG boasts a terrifying 1200 RPM rate of fire, capable of turning enemies into Swiss cheese. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Auto, Semi, Burst)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1200 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
infotexts.entityname.deep_ntw20: NTW-20 Anti-Materiel Sniper Rifle (Tungsten Physicorium Sniper)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ntw20: The NTW-20 uses massive 20x110mm anti-materiel rounds. It features three recoil suppression components: an internal hydraulic buffer, a buffer spring, and a muzzle brake, effectively reducing recoil. Warning: Do not use this behemoth without seasoned weapon handling experience. Consequences are your own. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Heavy Anti-Materiel Penalty: The lower your health, the lower the damage and accuracy.)‖end‖ (The trigger is heavy, requires holding LMB for 0.5s to fire) (Spread: 30, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 3, -60% Movement Speed) (Movement is nearly impossible while aiming)
infotexts.entitydescription.ntw_20mm: A massive 20mm anti-materiel round, possessing devastating damage and extremely high penetration power, easily pierces cover. (Armor Penetration: 1, Can penetrate doors and walls) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 10)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 10‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 400%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 20)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_gm6: GM6 "Lynx" Anti-Materiel Sniper Rifle (Tungsten Physicorium Sniper)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_gm6: When carried, the GM6 "Lynx" barrel can retract into the receiver, reducing the overall length to 928mm, shorter than a standard assault rifle. Combined with its light weight, this makes the rifle very suitable for single-person carry. It boasts the highest mobility among anti-materiel sniper rifles, and its rate of fire is also fast, capable of firing 5 rounds in 3 seconds. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.6, -10% Movement Speed) (Can be placed in inventory, no firing penalty)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_gm6_mag: Contains 10 rounds of 12.7x99mm anti-materiel ammunition. Combined with the Lynx's excellent mobility, it catches enemies off guard. (Armor Penetration: 0.8, Can penetrate doors and walls) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 8‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 300%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 15)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.8x_sight: 8x long-range sniper scope, used for lethal shots with sniper rifles. (-90% Spread, +30 Weapon Handling, +30% Damage, -20% Rate of Fire, -30% Movement Speed) ‖color:gui.red‖(Requires Lua: Provides extreme range bonus when aiming down sights (RMB))‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.1_3x_sight: A combo sight switchable between 1x and 3x magnification, integrating the advantages of two types of scopes. (-70% Spread, +25 Weapon Handling) ‖color:gui.red‖(Requires Lua: Provides significant range bonus when aiming down sights (RMB))‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Use Mouse Wheel to zoom)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.NTW_design: A very rare NTW-20 blueprint, used to craft its prototype firearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ghost_formula: ‖color:gui.red‖(Obtained as a reward after completing "Operation Ghost", is not consumed)‖end‖ Equipment used by the Ghost Squad, highly encrypted by the Coalition. Requires killing the Ghost Squad leader to obtain.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_grizzlies_formula: ‖color:gui.red‖(Obtained as a reward after completing 'Survival of the Fittest', is not consumed)‖end‖ Equipment used by the Grizzly Squad, highly encrypted by the Separatists. Requires killing the Grizzly Squad leader to obtain.
infotexts.entitydescription.gauss_design: A very rare Gauss Rifle blueprint, used to craft its prototype firearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.aa12_design: A very rare AA-12 blueprint, used to craft its prototype firearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.gm6_design: A very rare GM6 "Lynx" blueprint, used to craft its prototype firearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.whiteeagle_design: A very rare White Eagle blueprint, used to craft its prototype firearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.saintpredator_design: A very rare Saint Predator blueprint, used to craft its prototype firearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_44Magnum: A revolver using .44 Magnum ammunition. High flesh damage. Raising the gun activates "Iai", unloading 6 rounds into the enemy before you. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Full Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 8, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.1) (Deadeye charges for 2.5s, slows nearby creatures' movement speed, increases own rate of fire and damage resistance when active)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_44mag: Contains 6 rounds of .44 Magnum. Using a speedloader greatly increases reloading speed. (Armor Penetration: 0.35) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 3‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 5)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Titanium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_127Magnum: This behemoth uses 12.7x33mm pistol rounds, delivering extreme flesh damage. Using Physicorium tips increases penetration. Shooters can also attach a scope for improved accuracy. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.5, -20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_50glmag: Contains 7 rounds of .50GL, delivering devastating blows to flesh. (Armor Penetration: 0.6) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 6‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 12)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.m500_design: A very rare M500 blueprint, used to craft its prototype firearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m500Magnum: The M500 fires .50 Magnum rounds. Its massive caliber can directly pulverize unarmored targets. Additionally, sights can be attached for more precise and lethal shooting. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.5, -20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_50swmag: Contains 5 rounds of .50SW. This is the largest bullet you can find in a pistol. (Armor Penetration: 0.7) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 7)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 7‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 15)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_friendly_fire: The Friendship Shield identifies targets hit. When hitting a friendly target, it deploys a small shield around them, negating the bullet's kinetic energy. However, this component does not affect the user. Meaning, if friendlies do not have it installed, they can still damage you.
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_gun_in_water: Optimizes the bullet shape and enhances sealing, reducing the kinetic energy loss of bullets in water. (No damage falloff for bullets underwater)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_locate: An upgrade designed specifically for lone wolves. When you fall, friendlies can locate your position on the sonar.
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_first_aid: Installing a first aid sling on the firearm allows faster dragging of unconscious teammates. (+10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_rapid_receiver: Replaces the receiver with one capable of higher rate of fire, but increases recoil and reduces accuracy. ‖color:gui.red‖(Effects of the same type do not stack)‖end‖ (+15% Rate of Fire, +30% Spread)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_unstable_gunpowde: Uses higher-energy volatile gunpowder, increasing bullet kinetic energy, but causes the firearm to overheat faster. (+20% Damage, +50% Overheat Rate) ‖color:gui.red‖(Effects of the same type do not stack)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Increased overheat rate does not affect shotguns)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_improved_barrel: Uses an improved, reinforced barrel for more precise shooting and better heat resistance. ‖color:gui.red‖(Effects of the same type do not stack)‖end‖ (-20% Spread, +100% Overheat Recovery Rate)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_oc_gun: Heavily modifies the firearm to reach its theoretical rate of fire and significantly increase power, but drastically reduces accuracy and heat resistance. ‖color:gui.red‖(Effects of the same type do not stack)‖end‖ (+30% Rate of Fire, +30% Damage, +100% Overheat Rate, +80% Spread) ‖color:gui.red‖(Increased overheat rate does not affect shotguns)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_headshot: Adds a cap to the bullet tip, greatly increasing damage to the head, but significantly reduces the cavity effect, lowering damage to the body. ‖color:gui.red‖(Effects of the same type do not stack)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(+100% Headshot Damage)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(-50% Damage to Limbs and Torso)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_bodyshot: A bullet designed specifically to penetrate armor plates, but weakens penetration against highly angled helmets. ‖color:gui.red‖(Effects of the same type do not stack)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(+1 Penetration Level)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Only deals 20% Headshot Damage)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_cqb: Rigorous CQB training enhances your close-quarters combat capabilities, granting higher movement speed and stun resistance. (‖color:gui.red‖ During Indoor Combat‖end‖: +20% Movement Speed, 25% Stun Resistance, +10% Damage)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_frogman: Frogman training course, cultivating soldiers who can move freely underwater to quickly infiltrate enemy outposts. (‖color:gui.red‖ While Underwater‖end‖: +30% Swim Speed, 50% Water Current Resistance, +50% Oxygen Duration, 25% Stun Resistance, +10% Damage)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_marksman: Marksman is one of the security officer training branches, primarily aimed at cultivating cold, lethal shooters capable of one-shot kills. (When no enemies nearby: +50% Damage, -50% Spread, -20% Rate of Fire) ‖color:gui.red‖ (When enemies nearby: -20% Damage, -30% Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_commando: Commando training course, focuses on rapidly closing the distance with enemies, compressing their survival space, and gaining tactical advantage for our side. ‖color:gui.red‖(When no enemies nearby: +20% Speed, 25% Stun and Physical Damage Resistance, +50% Spread)‖end‖ (When enemies nearby: +20% Speed, 25% Stun and Physical Damage Resistance, +10% Rate of Fire, +20% Damage)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_heavy_defender: Heavy Defenders undergo rigorous training, wearing the heaviest and hardest armor, serving as the most solid shield in the task force. (Immune to plate debuffs) (Self and all nearby teammates: Gain 20% Physical, Stun, Shrapnel Residue Resistance) ‖color:gui.red‖(Self: -30% Damage and Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_blaster: After systematic course training, you master the use of explosive weapons, such as grenades, grenade launchers, rocket launchers, etc. +50% Explosion Damage +20% Explosion Radius +50% Throwing Distance When crafting, 40% chance not to consume one explosive item.
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_machinegunner: Machine Gunner training course, helps you become the most formidable firepower provider on the battlefield, the core of fire suppression. While holding an LMG, +8% damage for each nearby enemy, max 40% damage. While holding a GPMG, +8% rate of fire for each nearby enemy, max 40% rate of fire. Gain 40% Fatal Headshot Resistance to the head when crouching. ‖color:gui.red‖(When not crouching, -20% Headshot Resistance to the head)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_striker: Striker training guide, specializing in close-quarters combat, becoming the master of indoor CQB. Passive Effect: +20% Movement Speed, Gain 25% Physical and Stun Resistance. When enemies are nearby: -30% Spread, +10% Damage. When holding a shotgun, additional +40% Damage. ‖color:gui.red‖(When no enemies are nearby: +30% Spread, -20% Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_doc: Combat Medic, a medical soldier proficient in healing, yet their combat effectiveness should not be underestimated. (Medical Skill, Weapon Handling will not be lower than 60) (Unlocks the ability to drag personnel at full speed) (+20% Movement Speed, -50% Debuff Duration)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_ergonomics: Redesigns the armor for better ergonomics, improving human-machine interface. (+20 Weapon Handling, +20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_heavy_armor: Increases overall protection by using better Aramid plates and thickening the body armor, but sacrifices mobility and ergonomics. (Torso gains 20% Gunshot Wound, Shrapnel Residue Resistance) ‖color:gui.red‖(-20% Movement Speed, -20 Weapon Handling)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_strengthening_of_: The torso armor incorporates a blood flow control system. When limbs are injured, it automatically adjusts blood flow to the limbs, promptly reducing the harm caused by blood loss. (Limbs gain 90% Bleeding Resistance)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_emergency_defibri: A portable defibrillator is inserted inside the armor, triggering when the wearer suffers severe damage. Due to high power consumption, it can only trigger once per round. (When the primary health bar drops to 0, restores a large amount of health) ‖color:gui.red‖(Can only trigger once per round)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_light_mag: Uses lighter magazines with better ergonomics, increasing reload speed. (Only applicable to magazine-fed weapons)
infotexts.entitydescription.thermalgoggles_sight: 1x thermal sight, reveals enemy heat signatures. Ineffective against Husk-type enemies. 30Hz refresh rate significantly impacts shooting performance. (-30% Spread, -15 Weapon Handling) ‖color:gui.orange‖(Enable thermal imaging when aiming with RMB)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Thermal Range: 12 meters)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.thermalgoggles_sight_6: 6x thermal sight, reveals enemy heat signatures. Designed specifically for sniper rifles. 60Hz refresh rate provides good shooting feel. (-80% Spread, +25 Weapon Handling, -30% Movement Speed) ‖color:gui.orange‖(Enable thermal imaging when aiming with RMB)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Thermal Range: 20 meters)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Requires Lua: Provides long-range vision bonus when aiming down sights (RMB))‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m82a1: The M82A1 semi-automatic sniper rifle uses a short recoil principle and semi-automatic firing mode. Its large caliber 12.7x99mm (.50 BMG) ammunition delivers devastating impact. Warning: Do not use this behemoth without seasoned weapon handling experience. Consequences are your own. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Heavy Anti-Materiel Penalty: The lower your health, the lower the damage and accuracy.)‖end‖ (Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1, -40% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m82a1_blackice: An M82A1 Black Ice edition produced by the Deep Diving company. Hold your breath, steady your aim, fire. Warning: Do not use this behemoth without seasoned weapon handling experience. Consequences are your own. (Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1, -40% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ptrd: The PTRD-41 uses a rotating bolt action, manual loading, and automatic ejection. Simple structure, low manufacturing cost, suitable for mass production. Uses 14.5x114mm anti-materiel rounds, undeniable power. Downsides include slow single-shot loading, massive recoil, and noise. Warning: Do not use this behemoth without seasoned weapon handling experience. Consequences are your own. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Heavy Anti-Materiel Penalty: The lower your health, the lower the damage and accuracy.)‖end‖ (The trigger is heavy, requires holding LMB for 0.5s to fire) (Spread: 40, Damage Multiplier: 1, Reload: 3s, -60% Movement Speed, 0.5s Charge Time)
infotexts.entitydescription.ptrd_145mm: An anti-materiel round using high-energy propellant, very suitable for destroying hard targets. (Armor Penetration: 0.5, Can penetrate doors and walls) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 5)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 5‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 400%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 18)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m82a1_mag: Contains 10 rounds of .50 BMG. Uses expensive Physicorium as the tip and higher-energy Fulgurium powder as the propellant, capable of penetrating almost any armor. (Armor Penetration: 0.8, Can penetrate doors and walls) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 8‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 300%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 15)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_CZ75: The CZ75 standard design is a service pistol with a high-capacity magazine and double-action trigger. Its grip is ergonomically designed. The firing mechanism uses a double-action principle, making it simple and quick to operate. Combined with a 1000 RPM rate of fire, this pistol reigns supreme in close-range protection. ‖color:gui.red‖(When holding a pistol with health below 50%, triggers Mozambique Drill: +50% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Full Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1000 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_cz75mag: Contains 15 rounds of 9x19mm pistol ammunition. Uses Titanium tips for higher penetration. (Armor Penetration: 0.4) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 4‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 2)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Titanium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.gun_powder_fulgurium: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Made by mixing Fulgurium powder with conventional gunpowder. Possesses higher energy than regular gunpowder, commonly used for crafting advanced bullets. (Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)
infotexts.entitydescription.extended_barrel: The extended barrel attachment increases shooting accuracy and base damage. However, to prevent overheating damage, the firearm's rate of fire is reduced. Installation increases recoil, requiring higher weapon handling skill to compensate. ‖color:gui.red‖(Long Muzzle Device: Greatly increases effective range)‖end‖ (-30% Spread, +20% Damage, -15% Rate of Fire, -15 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_flash_hider: The flash hider allows the firearm to perform better during mobile shooting, excelling in maneuvering and offensive engagements. ‖color:gui.red‖(Short Muzzle Device: Slightly increases effective range)‖end‖ (While moving forward or backward: +20% Damage, -10% Spread, +10 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_compensator: The compensator performs better during defensive shooting, offering an advantage when firing from cover. ‖color:gui.red‖(Short Muzzle Device: Slightly increases effective range)‖end‖ (While stationary: +10% Damage, -10% Spread, +10 Weapon Handling, Gain 20% Damage Reduction)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_muzzle_brake: The muzzle brake effectively reduces firearm recoil, though the reduction is slightly weaker compared to other muzzle devices. ‖color:gui.red‖(Short Muzzle Device: Slightly increases effective range)‖end‖ (-30% Spread, +20 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_muffler: "SAKER ASR" black suppressor is perfect for assassination operations, greatly reducing gunshot noise and suppressing recoil. ‖color:gui.red‖(Long Muzzle Device: Greatly increases effective range)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Stealth Shot while crouching: +20% Lethal Headshot damage, +10% Gunshot Wound)‖end‖ (-80% Noise Range, -20% Spread, +30% Overheat Rate, -15 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_muffler_SOCOM: "Surefire SOCOM" suppressor, a tan suppressor manufactured by the Coalition, suitable for matching with tan firearm bodies. ‖color:gui.red‖(Long Muzzle Device: Greatly increases effective range)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Stealth Shot while crouching: +20% Lethal Headshot damage, +10% Gunshot Wound)‖end‖ (-80% Noise Range, -20% Spread, +30% Overheat Rate, -15 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_muffler_pistol: A black suppressor designed for pistols, excellent at suppressing sound. ‖color:gui.red‖(Note: This suppressor is a texture skin. Place it into a suppressor to change its texture.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_mac10: The MAC-10's design emphasizes compactness and portability. Its unique, box-like appearance is unforgettable. Uses .45 ACP ammunition, displaying astonishing lethality at close range. However, this comes with high recoil, requiring the shooter to invest more training and skill to master its firing. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 15, Damage: 1, Rate of Fire: 1200 RPM) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_mac: Contains 30 rounds of .45 ACP ammo, the "raindrops" specifically crafted for the Mac-10. (Armor Penetration: 0.3) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 3‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Leg Damage: +65%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 1)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Lead Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_mp5k: The MP5 SMG's action structure is similar to the G3 automatic rifle, using the same semi-free bolt and roller-locking mechanism. This results in a very low bolt head recoil velocity during unlocking, delaying the unlock time and reducing vibration during firing for better accuracy. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, Burst, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 800 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ump45: The UMP45 SMG's operating principle is no longer the traditional semi-free bolt action of the MP-5, but rather a simple blowback action. Compared to most SMGs that use a bolt-open, open-bolt structure, this design improves accuracy, and the trigger operation is very light and flexible. Additionally, to facilitate control during full-auto fire and reduce dispersion, the UMP45 is equipped with a rate reducer, limiting the rate of fire to 580 RPM. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, Burst, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 1.1, Rate of Fire: 600 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_ump45: Contains 25 rounds of .45 ACP ammo, an excellent choice for stopping enemies. (Armor Penetration: 0.3) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 3‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Leg Damage: +65%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 3)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Lead Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_ump45_phy: Contains 25 rounds of .45 ACP Physicorium ammo, high armor penetration. (Armor Penetration: 0.5) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 5)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 5‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Leg Damage: +65%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 3)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_ump45_tit: Contains 25 rounds of .45 ACP AP ammo. High stopping power + some armor penetration. (Armor Penetration: 0.4) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 4‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Leg Damage: +65%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 3)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Titanium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.ammobox_smg_lead: A box of SMG ammunition, containing a mix of lead bullets. Can reload approximately 60 magazines. (Suitable for lead SMG ammunition)
infotexts.entitydescription.ammobox_smg_tit: A box of SMG ammunition, containing a mix of titanium bullets. Can reload approximately 60 magazines. (Suitable for titanium SMG ammunition)
infotexts.entitydescription.ammobox_smg_phy: A box of SMG ammunition, containing a mix of physicorium bullets. Can reload approximately 60 magazines. (Suitable for physicorium SMG ammunition)
infotexts.entitydescription.ammoreload_smg_lead: Portable ammo loader, suitable for SMGs.
infotexts.entitydescription.ammoreload_smg_tit: Portable ammo loader, suitable for SMGs.
infotexts.entitydescription.ammoreload_smg_phy: Portable ammo loader, suitable for SMGs.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_mp5sd: The MP5SD's suppressor doesn't completely eliminate the sound of gunfire, but it can make it unrecognizable at a certain distance. The structure of the MP5SD suppressor involves 30 small holes (3mm diameter) drilled into the barrel, covered by a suppressor tube containing two separate gas expansion chambers. During firing, some propellant gas enters the rear expansion chamber through the barrel holes, reducing gas pressure and thus decreasing the acceleration of the moving bullet. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, Burst, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Stealth Shot while crouching: +20% Lethal Headshot damage, +10% Gunshot Wound)‖end‖ (-80% Noise Range, -20% Spread) ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 100) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1.0, Rate of Fire: 800 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_p90: The P90 SMG is the world's first personal defense weapon using entirely new ammunition. The P90 uses high-velocity 5.7mm bullets. Its heavy magazine holds 50 rounds, and it has a high rate of fire of 14 rounds per second. The 5.7x28mm ammunition can easily penetrate level III, IV, and even V body armor. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 130) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 850 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_pdw: Looks like a pistol, yet like an SMG, and also a bit like a rifle. This new type of individual weapon combines the advantages of pistols, SMGs, and rifles, opening a new era in military small arms. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, Burst, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 130) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 800 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_p90: Contains 50 rounds of 5.7mm ammunition, easily penetrates body armor. (Armor Penetration: 0.6) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 6‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 0.8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Titanium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_smg_p90_du: P90 SMG Depleted Uranium Penetrator Magazine
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_p90_du: Contains 50 rounds of 5.7mm depleted uranium ammunition. Can penetrate friendly targets to deal effective damage to enemies. (Armor Penetration: 0.6) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 6‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can penetrate friendly targets, cannot deal damage to friendlies)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Targets hit suffer -30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 0.8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Depleted Uranium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_p90_phy: Contains 50 rounds of 5.7mm Physicorium ammunition, can penetrate high-level armor plates. (Armor Penetration: 0.7) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 7)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 7‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 0.8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_p90_fu: Contains 50 rounds of 5.7mm Fulgurium Physicorium ammunition, high penetration level. (Armor Penetration: 0.8) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 8‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 0.8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Fulgurium Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_p90_ap: Contains 50 rounds of 5.7mm Tungsten Physicorium ammunition, achieving a level 9 penetration rating. (Armor Penetration: 0.9, Can penetrate doors and walls) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 9)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 9‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 0.8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Tungsten Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_medical_kit_small: A small, portable medical kit, perfect for EVA, wreck salvaging, and other missions. ‖color:gui.red‖(Can treat most wounds)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Healing Speed: Medium)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Interval: 3s)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(5 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_medical_kit: An individual first aid kit for rapid wound treatment. Standard issue for every soldier. ‖color:gui.red‖(Can treat most wounds)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Healing Speed: Fast)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Interval: 3s)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(10 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_medical_kit_wound: A small trauma kit that can treat wounds at the fastest speed. The downside is its limited supply of medical items. ‖color:gui.red‖(Can treat most wounds)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Healing Speed: Very Fast)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Interval: 1.5s)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(5 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_medical_kit_slow: A large medkit containing various medical supplies. Longer application time per use, but higher total healing amount. More suitable for low-intensity combat missions. ‖color:gui.red‖(Can treat most wounds)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Healing Speed: Slow)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Interval: 10s)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(20 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_medical_kit_grizz: A large medical backpack. Its massive capacity can hold almost any medical supply. Highly favored by Grizzly Squad medics. ‖color:gui.red‖(Can treat most wounds)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Occupies backpack slot, can carry many items)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Healing Speed: Very Fast)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Interval: 5s)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(10 uses)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Slowly regenerates durability, does not disappear at 0 durability)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(When durability < 10, application interval becomes 10s)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_medical_surgical_: A surgical toolkit used for removing shrapnel lodged in the body. ‖color:gui.red‖(Can only treat Shrapnel Residue, Fatal Headshot)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Healing Speed: Very Fast)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Interval: 3s)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(20 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_medical_tournique: A CAT tourniquet can stop major bleeding. An essential medical supply for every soldier.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_medical_Hemostati: DOC hemostatic agent quickly stops bleeding and can be used multiple times. ‖color:gui.red‖(10 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_medical_ai2: The AI-2 medkit contains various medications, such as broad-spectrum antibiotics, anti-radiation drugs, morphine, painkillers, and other emergency agents. Note: This medkit is designed for emergency use and may have side effects. ‖color:gui.red‖(Contains effects of Broad-Spectrum Antibiotics, Anti-Radiation Drugs, Morphine, Antidote, Paralysis Cure)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Significant side effects after each use)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Time: 3s, 5 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_metamizole: A small blister pack of Metamizole painkillers, capable of alleviating the negative effects of pain. Unfortunately, the effect doesn't last very long. ‖color:gui.blue‖(90s Pain Relief: Aiming with injured arms will not sway, injured legs will not reduce movement speed)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Time: 3s, 4 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ibuprofen: A bottle of Ibuprofen painkillers, mainly used to relieve mild to moderate pain. An essential item for every soldier. ‖color:gui.blue‖(270s Pain Relief: Aiming with injured arms will not sway, injured legs will not reduce movement speed)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Time: 5s, 15 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_Vaseline: A tin of Vaseline. Smearing it on your forehead makes you feel refreshed! ‖color:gui.blue‖(300s Pain Relief: Aiming with injured arms will not sway, injured legs will not reduce movement speed)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Time: 5s, 6 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_goldenstar: A tin of Golden Star balm. Applying it to your philtrum causes a burning sensation but wakes you right up. Also, this thing is hard to open. ‖color:gui.blue‖(350s Pain Relief: Aiming with injured arms will not sway, injured legs will not reduce movement speed)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Application Time: 6s, 10 uses)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_mp7: The MP7 resembles a pistol in appearance. When firing, the shooter can either extend the telescopic stock for shoulder firing or, with training, hold it like a pistol. The MP7 uses 4.6x30mm ammunition, derived by shortening the experimental HK36 assault rifle's 4.6x36mm cartridge. It features low recoil and moderate power. Equipped with a tactical minimap to better understand enemy distribution in outposts. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, Burst, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Burst: +10% Damage, -50% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.2s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1000 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)
infotexts.entityname.deep_smg_mp7_du: MP7 SMG Depleted Uranium Penetrator Magazine
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_mp7_du: Contains 40 rounds of 4.6mm depleted uranium ammunition. Can penetrate friendly targets to deal effective damage to enemies. (Armor Penetration: 0.6) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 6‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 0.8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Depleted Uranium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_mp7: Contains 40 rounds of 4.6mm ammunition. Uses Physicorium tips, allowing it to penetrate most armor. Downside is low stopping power. (Armor Penetration: 0.7) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 7)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 7‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 0.8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_mp7_fu: Contains 40 rounds of 4.6mm Fulgurium Physicorium ammunition. Excellent armor penetration, but low stopping power. (Armor Penetration: 0.8) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 8‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 0.8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Fulgurium Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_mp7_ap: Contains 40 rounds of 4.6mm Tungsten Physicorium ammunition. Extremely high penetration, but low flesh damage. (Armor Penetration: 0.9, Can penetrate doors and walls) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 9)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 9‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 250%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 0.8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Tungsten Physicorium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_shotgun: Gain 1 token for each enemy killed during a round. Firing a Deep Diving Armory shotgun consumes one token and grants 50 experience points. (Token count is unlimited, but resets at the end of the round.)
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_shotgun_2: Your mastery of shotguns grows. Killing an enemy grants an additional 50 experience, and the Captain rewards you with 20 Marks!
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_shotgun_3: Nobody on Europa handles a shotgun better than you. When attacking close-range enemies with a Physicorium shotgun, rate of fire increases!
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_doublebarrel: This old relic dates back to the early 19th century. Even now on Europa, people still use this simple and reliable old friend. ‖color:gui.red‖(Gain 50 experience points for each enemy killed with this shotgun.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 0.1, Damage Multiplier: 1.6, Rate of Fire: 0.2)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_12shell: Shotgun shell loaded with 12 lead pellets. Deadly at close range. ‖color:gui.red‖(Significant damage falloff against targets beyond 9 meters)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Note: Only Deep Diving Armory shotguns have damage falloff at range)‖end‖ (Armor Penetration: 0.1) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 1‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(+100% Leg Damage, deals 1.5x damage to Deep Diving elite enemies)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_12shell_tigershar: A deadly shotgun shell developed by the Separatists, mixing titanium tips with copper pellets. Due to the severe wounds it inflicts, it's nicknamed "Tigershark" by the Separatist military. ‖color:gui.red‖(Significant damage falloff against targets beyond 9 meters)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Note: Only Deep Diving Armory shotguns have damage falloff at range)‖end‖ (Armor Penetration: 0.4) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 4‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(+100% Leg Damage, deals 1.5x damage to Deep Diving elite enemies)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_12shell_boneshark: An advanced version of the Tigershark ammunition, using Physicorium tips, making it even deadlier. ‖color:gui.red‖(Significant damage falloff against targets beyond 9 meters)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Note: Only Deep Diving Armory shotguns have damage falloff at range)‖end‖ (Armor Penetration: 0.6) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 6‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(+100% Leg Damage, deals 1.5x damage to Deep Diving elite enemies)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_12shell_arrow: Top-tier ammunition among 12/70 shotgun shells. Flechettes possess high penetration, capable of piercing advanced plates. ‖color:gui.red‖(Significant damage falloff when attacking enemies beyond a 9-meter radius)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Note: Only Deep Diving Armory shotguns have damage falloff at long range)‖end‖ (Armor Penetration: 0.8) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 8‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(+100% Leg Damage, deals 1.5x damage to Deep Diving elite enemies)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_slug: Loaded with a single massive 18.4mm slug. A deadly threat at both close and long range. (Armor Penetration: 0.5) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 5)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 5‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 6)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_slug_phy: Loaded with a single massive 18.4mm Physicorium slug. A deadly threat at both close and long range. (Armor Penetration: 0.7) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 7)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 7‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 7)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_slug_AP: Special AP-20 slug, providing higher armor penetration. (Armor Penetration: 0.8) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 8‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 8)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_birdshot: BBB-grade birdshot loaded with 77 small 4.83mm steel pellets. Very suitable for clearing small targets. (Armor Penetration: 0.1) ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 1‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_1887: The M1887 shotgun is designed for lever-action, capable of firing powerful 12 gauge shells. It is made of iron and wood, weighing about 3.6 kg with a total length of about 1.2 meters. The chamber holds five rounds, utilizing lever action to chamber a new round and eject the spent shell. The lever-action mechanism represented a major innovation at the time, although it was slower to operate than later pump-action or semi-automatic firearms. ‖color:gui.red‖(Each kill with this shotgun grants 50 experience points.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 5s, Spread: 0.1, Damage Multiplier: 1.4, Rate of Fire: 0.8)
infotexts.entityname.deep_m1_garand: M1 Garand Semi-Automatic Rifle (Steel Sniper Rifle)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m1_garand: The M1 Garand rifle operates on a gas-operated principle with a rotating bolt locking mechanism. The M1 Garand has a distinctive feeding system: a double-row, 8-round steel en-bloc clip is pressed into the magazine well from the top of the receiver. When the final round is fired, the bolt locks back, and the clip is automatically ejected by the clip latch, emitting a characteristic "ping" sound to remind the soldier to reload. Might bite the soldier's thumb. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.3)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sks: The SKS semi-automatic rifle fires 7.62x39mm intermediate cartridges and is fed by a 10-round stripper clip. The 7.62x39mm intermediate cartridge delivers low recoil and high accuracy. Among the Separatists, recruits frequently use this rifle for training. Due to its outstanding performance, some veterans continue to use it. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.3)
infotexts.entityname.deep_56ban: Type 56 Semi-Automatic Rifle (Type 56 Carbine) (Steel Sniper Rifle)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_56ban: The Type 56 semi-automatic rifle is copied from the SKS with several improvements. It features lightweight design, superb shooting accuracy, and highly reliable action, and comes with a folding bayonet for close-quarters bayonet fighting in emergencies. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.23)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m14: The M14 features a wooden stock and a metal receiver as its core structure, operating on a gas-operated principle. While adding a 20-round magazine, it retains the ability to be loaded via stripper clips. Uses 7.62x51mm full-power rounds. The larger magazine capacity provides sustained, long-lasting firepower. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.2)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_fn49: The FN-49 semi-automatic rifle is large and heavy, weighing about 4.3 kg empty, measuring about 1117mm long, and firing full-power military rifle cartridges. Uses 7.92x57mm Mauser rounds, offering immense power and high shooting accuracy, though it is somewhat cumbersome. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 1, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.5, -20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_gew43: The Gew43 rifle utilizes a combat-proven short-stroke piston gas-operated system. Its locking mechanism is also highly reliable. Uses 7.92x57mm Mauser rifle rounds, offering weapon stability and good mobility. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.4, +10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_Mosin: The Mosin-Nagant rifle is a manually operated bolt-action rifle fed by an internal box magazine, designed for smokeless powder cartridges. Overall length is 1020mm, weight is 3.9kg, and the magazine holds 5 rounds (plus 1 in the chamber). This rifle features outstanding shooting accuracy and stable performance. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1.4)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_M1903: The M1903 Springfield rifle is chambered in 7.62mm, with a total length of 1097mm, empty weight of 3.9kg, magazine capacity of 5 rounds, rate of fire of 10 RPM, and an effective range of 800 meters. Its action operates as a rotating bolt. High power, high accuracy, though the bolt-pull is relatively slow. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 1, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1.7)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_Lee: The Lee-Enfield rifle, chambered in 7.7mm, is commonly referred to as the "British Seven-Seven." Its magazine holds ten rounds. With training, veterans can discharge 30 rounds in a single minute. Extremely fast rate of fire, serving as a lethal weapon in the hands of veterans. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.9)
infotexts.entityname.deep_type_38: Arisaka Type 38 Sniper Rifle (Type 38) (Steel Sniper Rifle)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_type_38: An old Type 38 rifle holding 5 rounds of 6.5x50mm Arisaka rifle ammunition. Known as the "Type 38" due to its massive dust cover. Due to its cheap production cost, it continues to serve on Europa today. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1.7)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_98k: The famous Kar98k rifle, born five centuries ago on Earth. Boasting high shooting precision, it can be deployed as an outstanding sniper rifle when equipped with a 4x or 6x optical scope. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1.5, +10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entityname.deep_zhongzheng: Chiang Kai-shek Sniper Rifle (Steel Sniper Rifle)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_zhongzheng: The Chiang Kai-shek rifle is copied from the Mauser 1924 rifle. It features simple operation, rugged durability, powerful fire, and excellent tactical mobility. Though highly dated, it remains more than capable of sniping down enemies. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1.2, +15% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_AWM: The AWM sniper rifle is 1180mm long, with a 660mm barrel, chambered in .338 Lapua Magnum (8.6mm caliber). Although it is less powerful than sniper rifles chambered in 12.7mm, it delivers superior mobility and precision, making it perfect for exact enemy elimination. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1.4, -30% Movement Speed) ‖color:gui.red‖(6-8x Scope Ergonomics: Medium)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sv98: The SV-98 is a bolt-action sniper rifle with a manual bolt operation. The bolt head is designed with three evenly distributed locking lugs that lock into the corresponding recesses in the receiver to complete the cycling action. Chambered in 7.62x54R, it features high accuracy and high magazine capacity, though it requires frequent maintenance. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1.2, -10% Movement Speed) ‖color:gui.red‖(6-8x Scope Ergonomics: High)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m700: The Remington 700's bolt mechanism is the hallmark of its design. Upon chambering, the casing head is completely enclosed by the bolt recess. When fully in battery, the bolt head is wrapped by the barrel breech, and encased by the receiver. This layered enclosure makes the Remington 700 action one of the safest in existence. The rifle uses 7.62x51mm rounds, is lightweight and compact, with a comfortable stock, making it a highly praised weapon among security officers. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1.4, +15% Movement Speed, +10 Weapon Handling) ‖color:gui.red‖(6-8x Scope Ergonomics: High)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_r93: The R93 rifle features a straight-pull bolt action and a collet locking system. While a traditional rotating bolt handle requires a 60° rotation during operation, the R93's straight-pull system cancels out the rotating action, using expandable locking collets instead of traditional lugs. Its unique straight-pull design allows the shooter to cycle rapidly, providing tremendous sustained fire when paired with high-capacity magazines. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2.5s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.9, -20% Movement Speed) ‖color:gui.red‖(6-8x Scope Ergonomics: High)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_sr25: SR-25 Designated Marksman Rifle (Titanium Sniper Rifle)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sr25: The SR-25 Designated Marksman Rifle chambered in 7.62x51mm has a total length of 1118mm and outstanding shooting precision. Equipped with a 20-round magazine, it stands as one of the most popular weapons among security officers. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.3)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_dp28: The DP machine gun has a simple structure with only 65 parts, requiring low manufacturing precision. It uses a gas-operated system with a flap-locking mechanism, fed by a pan magazine. The pan magazine consists of upper and lower discs clamped together; the upper disc rotates via a spring, continuously feeding bullets to the feed port. Uses 7.62x54mm rifle rounds, providing reliable firepower. ‖color:gui.red‖(-70% Spread while crouching with a machine gun)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Full Auto)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 150) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 18, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 600 RPM, -30% Movement Speed)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_rpk: Developed from the AKM assault rifle as a squad automatic weapon. Uses a 75-round drum magazine. Empty weight 5.6 kg, sight radius 560 mm. Easy to manufacture, durable, reliable, low failure rate, usable under various harsh conditions, simple weapon operation, rapid sustained fire. ‖color:gui.red‖(-70% Spread while crouching with a machine gun)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 16, Damage Multiplier: 1.4, Rate of Fire: 600 RPM, -30% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entityname.deep_m60: M60E4 General Purpose Machine Gun (Titanium Machine Gun)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m60: The M60 machine gun is chambered in 7.62mm, uses a gas-operated system and rotating bolt locking mechanism. The M60 features low weight, compact structure, high firepower, good accuracy, and wide application. Its rate of fire is not high, but accuracy is relatively good, with strong sustained firepower. ‖color:gui.red‖(-70% Spread while crouching with a machine gun)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Full Auto)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 170) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 6s, Spread: 16, Damage Multiplier: 1.5, Rate of Fire: 550 RPM, -40% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entityname.deep_rpk16: RPK-16 Light Machine Gun (Titanium Machine Gun)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_rpk16: The RPK-16 combines the length of an assault rifle with the firepower of a light machine gun. Its heavy barrel can withstand prolonged continuous fire, providing excellent fire suppression capability. Stable, reliable, resistant to overheating, stable firing. ‖color:gui.red‖(-70% Spread while crouching with a machine gun)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 160) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 15, Damage Multiplier: 1.5, Rate of Fire: 700 RPM, -20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entityname.deep_m249: M249 Light Machine Gun (Physicorium Machine Gun)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m249: The M249 uses a new hydraulic-pneumatic recoil buffer to reduce recoil. Features a rotating gas regulator suitable for different firing environments. Fires 5.56x45 ammunition, featuring high rate of fire and high mobility. ‖color:gui.red‖(-70% Spread while crouching with a machine gun)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Full Auto)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 180) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 4.5s, Spread: 12, Damage Multiplier: 1.5, Rate of Fire: 800 RPM, -20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entityname.deep_pkp: PKP General Purpose Machine Gun (Physicorium Machine Gun)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_pkp: The PKP GPMG uses a new heavy barrel with longitudinal cooling fins covered by a metal shroud with an integrated carrying handle. This forced air cooling barrel cannot be quickly changed. This design improves barrel cooling efficiency and reduces the probability of PKP malfunction. This machine gun uses 7.62x54R rifle rounds, delivering high damage. ‖color:gui.red‖(-70% Spread while crouching with a machine gun)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Full Auto)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 190) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 8s, Spread: 14, Damage Multiplier: 1.5, Rate of Fire: 600 RPM, -30% Movement Speed)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_mg42: The MG-42 GPMG is chambered in 7.92mm, firing 7.92x57mm Mauser rifle rounds. Overall length 1219mm, barrel length 533mm. This machine gun has an extremely fast rate of fire. Its tearing sound is the most feared sound by enemies. ‖color:gui.red‖(-70% Spread while crouching with a machine gun)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Full Auto)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 210) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 4.5s, Spread: 18, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1200 RPM, -40% Movement Speed)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_pp19: The Bizon SMG uses the most common blowback operation principle for SMGs. Its most distinctive feature is the 64-round cylindrical magazine made of composite material. Rate of fire is between 650 and 700 RPM. Can use standard and reinforced Makarov pistol rounds. Suitable for various tactical missions. Equipped with a stock made from alien ore strands. In combat, the user seems to ignore pain until the moment of death. ‖color:gui.red‖(When holding this gun, you will not fall and have no fear of death)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 150) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 700 RPM) (Provides resistance to water currents) (+15% Movement Speed, Provides Stun and Physical Damage Resistance)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_short_doublebarre: This simple and brutal little guy can fire 12 gauge shells. And you can dual wield them! ‖color:gui.red‖(Gain 50 experience points for each enemy killed with this shotgun.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 0.1, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 0.2)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m590: The M590 excels in accuracy, reliability, and handling. It provides stable and precise shooting performance, whether in long-range or close-range combat. Its pump-action feeding makes rapid loading and operation more convenient, ensuring continuous firepower output. ‖color:gui.red‖(Gain 100 experience points and 20 Marks for each enemy killed with this shotgun.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Pump Action)‖end‖ (Reload: 4s, Spread: 0.1, Damage Multiplier: 1.6, Rate of Fire: 0.8)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m870: As a pump-action shotgun, the M870 offers extremely high performance during building entry assaults or defense. It incorporates many new processes and accessories, such as phosphate surface treatment, ramped front sight, adjustable notch rear sight, and is equipped with an extended tubular magazine holding 7 rounds. Favored by assault soldiers. ‖color:gui.red‖(Gain 100 experience points and 20 Marks for each enemy killed with this shotgun. +20% Rate of Fire when enemies are nearby.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Pump Action)‖end‖ (Reload: 4s, Spread: 0.1, Damage Multiplier: 1.8, Rate of Fire: 0.8, +15% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_bosg: The BOSG uses a break-action mechanism, holding 2 shotgun shells. Extremely high burst damage at close range. After mastering the reload interval, this shotgun becomes a highly threatening weapon. ‖color:gui.red‖(Gain 100 experience points and 20 Marks for each enemy killed with this shotgun.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 0.1, Damage Multiplier: 2, Rate of Fire: 0.2)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m4_super90: The M4 Super90 shotgun features a new design called "Auto-Regulating Gas-Operated" (ARGO). infotexts.entityname.m82a1_blackice: Deep Diving Armory M82A1 Black Ice Paint
infotexts.entitydescription.m82a1_blackice: An M82A1 Black Ice paint produced by the Deep Diving company. Hold your breath, steady your aim, fire.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_gersuit_female: An officer's uniform from about 5 centuries ago. Exquisitely designed, with multiple pockets. ‖color:gui.blue‖(Beautification Pack: Europa Moe Project)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Do not wear beautification clothes on vanilla characters. Not responsible for eye sores.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.gersuit: An officer's uniform from about 5 centuries ago. Exquisitely designed, with multiple pockets.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ger_hat: A black officer's cap, signifying one's status.
infotexts.entitydescription.green_combat_suit: Standard issue combat suit for Separatist soldiers. Made with Kevlar fabric to reduce the chance of injury from shrapnel. Equipped with 4 pockets for storing combat supplies.
infotexts.entitydescription.brown_combat_suit: Standard issue combat suit for Coalition soldiers. Lightweight and comfortable, equipped with 4 pockets for placing combat supplies.
infotexts.entitydescription.ghost_suit: Custom combat suit for the Ghost Squad. Features high mobility and storage space. Ghost Squad members often wear this suit for infiltration operations.
infotexts.entitydescription.grizzlies_suit: Grizzly Squad custom combat suit. Made with highly waterproof fabric and features additional soft armor inserts, providing ample protection for the Grizzly Squad. ‖color:gui.red‖(When wearing the Grizzly Combat Suit and arm plates are equipped in the body armor, the arms gain an additional 10% damage resistance)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.breton_top: A shirt with blue and white stripes. Among Separatists, only veteran soldiers are qualified to wear it. "Behind the eternal, intoxicating fog lies the coast of the motherland." (+10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.103_suit: A stylish casual garment. The knitted fabric provides warmth for your journey into the abyss, while the soft Kevlar lining underneath offers basic protection. ‖color:gui.blue‖(Texture provided by: jijk103)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Beautification Pack: Europa Moe Project)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Do not wear beautification clothes on vanilla characters. Not responsible for eye sores.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.103_hat: An exquisite Scottish knit cap, designed to be worn with the Knitted Hoodie. ‖color:gui.blue‖(Texture provided by: jijk103)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Beautification Pack: Europa Moe Project)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Do not wear beautification clothes on vanilla characters. infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sakiko_suit: Sakiko Togawa is a member of Ave Mujica. As a young lady, she accidentally arrived on Europa. Fortunately, Deep Diving Armory's PigCat Senpai found her unconscious and started the girl's military life. ‖color:gui.blue‖(Beautification Pack: Europa Moe Project)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(This clothing can overwrite vanilla textures, will not cause eye sores.)‖end‖

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_fort: Fort "Fortress", heavy armor developed by the Separatist heavy assault team, drawing from years of combat experience against the Coalition. It features a comprehensive protection design, but its significant drawback is that soldiers cannot operate in it for extended periods. ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms, Thighs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.7)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.05)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Additional Support: Arm Plates, Groin Plate)‖end‖ (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-40% Movement Speed)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_fort_t5: Fort "Heavy Cavalry", the final modification of the Fort body armor by the Separatists. It surpasses the old 6B43 model in mobility and represents the culmination of Separatist heavy armor technology. ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms, Thighs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.7)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.05)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Additional Support: Arm Plates, Groin Plate)‖end‖ (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-20% Movement Speed)
