It offers strong torso protection and provides high damage reduction when the lining is penetrated. ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Additional Support: Arm Plates)‖end‖ (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_Guardian: The Guardian body armor was developed by the Coalition, aiming to reduce weight while protecting vital areas. Offers the protection area of heavy body armor but is lighter. ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.9)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_tactec: Tactec plate carrier rig, standard issue for Coalition soldiers, combines a plate carrier vest with a chest rig, balancing storage and protection. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Incompatible with chest rigs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 2)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.9)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ (12 Storage Slots) (Can install different plates for corresponding protection)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m1: The M1 plate carrier rig provides soldiers with high plate protection. Storage pouches on the rig can hold spare ammunition. Favored by Separatist soldiers. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Incompatible with chest rigs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 2)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ (12 Storage Slots) (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-5% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_osprey: Osprey assault plate carrier rig, highly favored by Coalition special forces, integrates protection, mobility, and carrying capacity, providing the best plate carrier rig for special operators. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Incompatible with chest rigs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 2)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.9)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.05)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Additional Support: Arm Plates)‖end‖ (16 Storage Slots) (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_Obsidian: "Obsidian" heavy plate carrier rig, the Coalition's effective response to Separatist heavy armor. Coalition soldiers focus more on ergonomics; their plate carrier rigs are lighter and more practical compared to the Separatists'. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Incompatible with chest rigs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms, Thighs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.75)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.05)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Additional Support: Arm Plates)‖end‖ (16 Storage Slots) (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entityname.gen4_heavy: Gen4 Heavy Plate Carrier Vest (Assault Model)
infotexts.entitydescription.gen4_heavy: Coalition's fourth-generation plate carrier vest. Modular and fully scalable, the GEN4 can easily be modified for enhanced protection. This version is enhanced with hand protection, and the inner lining is replaced with stronger Aramid plates. ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.05)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Additional Support: Arm Plates)‖end‖ (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-25% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_6b43: Type 6B43 Class 6A heavy body armor. Ultra-heavy body armor developed by the Separatists for high-risk missions, offering extreme protection. Generally issued to Separatist elite heavy troopers. ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms, Thighs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.7)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.05)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Additional Support: Arm Plates, Groin Plate)‖end‖ (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-30% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_hpc: A plate carrier made from active fiber. Provides no protection itself; relies entirely on inserted plates. Its advantage lies in low cost and minimal impact on shooter mobility. (Protection Area: Torso) (+20% Movement Speed) (Can install different plates for corresponding protection)
infotexts.entitydescription.thor: A black integrated plate carrier vest. Almost no impact on movement speed. Built-in ballistic fibers defend against small shrapnel and small caliber rounds. Additionally, plates can be installed for higher protection levels. ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 2)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.9)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ (Can install different plates for corresponding protection)
infotexts.entitydescription.tanzan_m22: The M22 chest rig is designed for operators. Made of non-absorbent fabric, it has 12 storage slots for magazines, medical kits, grenades, etc. Includes a long-range radio to maintain contact with teammates. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Occupies headset slot, incompatible with plate carrier rigs)‖end‖ (+10% Movement Speed) (12 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_commando: Commando chest rig, common among Coalition security forces. Initially designed for riot control, so ammunition capacity is limited. Includes a long-range radio to maintain contact with teammates. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Occupies headset slot, incompatible with plate carrier rigs)‖end‖ (+10% Movement Speed) (12 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_alpha: The Alpha chest rig offers large capacity and portability. Made of waterproof fabric, it's a well-balanced rig in all aspects. Includes a long-range radio to maintain contact with teammates. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Occupies headset slot, incompatible with plate carrier rigs)‖end‖ (16 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_coalition: Coalition chest rig, standard issue for Coalition military. The war between the Coalition and Separatists has lasted decades, only the Coalition chest rig remains unchanged. Includes a long-range radio to maintain contact with teammates. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Occupies headset slot, incompatible with plate carrier rigs)‖end‖ (16 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_separatists: The Separatists chest rig was developed over years of fighting the Coalition. It can hold a large amount of ammunition and features high ergonomics. Includes a long-range radio to maintain contact with teammates. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Occupies headset slot, incompatible with plate carrier rigs)‖end‖ (-10% Movement Speed) (24 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_mk3: MK3 chest rig, high capacity, provides the shooter with sustained firepower and ample medical supplies. Includes a long-range radio to maintain contact with teammates. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Occupies headset slot, incompatible with plate carrier rigs)‖end‖ (-10% Movement Speed) (24 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m43: M43 chest rig, black concealed type. Can carry a certain amount of ammunition. Includes a long-range radio to maintain contact with teammates. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Occupies headset slot, incompatible with plate carrier rigs)‖end‖ (+10% Movement Speed) (12 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_Ghost: Ghost chest rig, lightweight and comfortable, favored by infiltration units. Includes a long-range radio to maintain contact with teammates. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Occupies headset slot, incompatible with plate carrier rigs)‖end‖ (16 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_thunder: Thunder chest rig. When you need to carry a large amount of combat supplies, the Thunder chest rig is your good partner. Includes a long-range radio to maintain contact with teammates. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Occupies headset slot, incompatible with plate carrier rigs)‖end‖ (-10% Movement Speed) (24 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_bb102: BB-102 assault backpack, standard issue for Separatist soldiers. 16-liter capacity, equipped with adjustable straps. Can hold most combat items. (24 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_t20: T20 assault backpack, common among Coalition soldiers. High portability and some storage space. (20 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_t30: T30 medium backpack is an upgraded version of the T20. Maximizes storage space without affecting ergonomics. Highly praised among Coalition soldiers. (30 Storage Slots) ‖color:gui.red‖(The first slot can hold large two-handed weapons)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_t30_black: Black version of the T30 medium backpack. More discreet. (30 Storage Slots) ‖color:gui.red‖(The first slot can hold large two-handed weapons)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ghost_bag: Standard issue backpack for the Ghost Squad. Small and lightweight. (20 Storage Slots)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_attack2: The Attack-2 backpack can carry a large amount of items. The backpack features an expandable main compartment, two side pockets, a pocket on the front, two pockets formed between the main compartment and side pockets, and a top flap with a zippered pocket. (-30% Movement Speed, -20 Weapon Handling) ‖color:gui.red‖(Can hold a diving suit and a toolbelt)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(30 Storage Slots, can hold medium-sized items)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_beta2: Beta-2 heavy backpack. A good choice when Separatists need to carry a large amount of military supplies. (-30% Movement Speed, -20 Weapon Handling) ‖color:gui.red‖(Can hold a diving suit and a toolbelt)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(30 Storage Slots, can hold medium-sized items)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_6sh118: 6sh118 heavy backpack, featuring the largest storage space. Main pack 60 liters, with 20 liters of additional space on each side. Can carry back everything you encounter. (-40% Movement Speed, -40 Weapon Handling) ‖color:gui.red‖(36 Storage Slots, can hold anything)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.6b47: The 6B47 is a Kevlar helmet. Ballistic performance is the same as its predecessor, but lighter, even buoyant. The 6B47 helmet features a modular design. A Picatinny rail on the right side allows users to attach flashlights, identification lights, etc. The central mount can be used to install night vision devices or camera equipment. ‖color:gui.green‖(20% chance of ricochet, head takes no damage)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(No face shield, Protection Level 0)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install tactical equipment)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Neural Adjustment upgrades)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.6b47_npc: A privately modified 6B47 helmet. Reliability is increased, but tactical equipment cannot be installed. Recommended to deconstruct and craft a standard 6B47 helmet. ‖color:gui.green‖(20% chance of ricochet, head takes no damage)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(No face shield, Protection Level 0)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Neural Adjustment upgrades)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.6b47_npc_night4: A privately modified 6B47 helmet with non-removable night vision goggles. Reliability is greatly increased. infotexts.entitydescription.deep_kiver_m: The Fort heavy helmet was developed by the Separatist heavy assault team. Its unique multi-component protective structure can fully absorb the impact energy of bullets transmitted to the head and cervical spine. The double-layer ballistic face shield provides good protection against small caliber rounds. Downside is incompatibility with headsets. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Incompatible with Deep Diving Armory headsets)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(50% chance of ricochet, head takes no damage)‖end‖‖color:gui.red‖Overmatched by bullets with ≥6 penetration, ricochet chance ignored‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.05)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Neural Adjustment upgrades)‖end‖ (-10% Movement Speed)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_altyn: The Altyn heavy helmet achieves extreme protection. infotexts.entitydescription.gpnvg_18: GPNVG-18 quad-eye night vision goggles, mounted on the helmet, allow seeing in the darkest abyss, leaving enemies hidden in the dark nowhere to hide. ‖color:gui.red‖(Mounts on helmet)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Turn off tactical equipment button to swap)‖end‖

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_supernova: A specially modified shotgun equipped with a suppressor. 7-round magazine capacity, fires 12 gauge shells. infotexts.entitydescription.deep_vhs_d3_baka: Baka's exclusive weapon, from Battlefield 2042. infotexts.entitydescription.deep_wuchuan: MiaoMiao's exclusive weapon. The powerful MiaoMiao used the 'Parry Stick Flow' to flawlessly defeat Teacher Yin Hu, obtaining this copper-poured, iron-cast great blade. ‖color:gui.blue‖(When the Wuchuan (Dark Wind) rises, retreat to survive, advance to conquer. Can block with the blade, or dash forward like the wind. Right-click to charge stance. Enemy attacks on Wuchuan accelerate the charge. When the charge bar is full, activate Swift Step (Sata). Swift Step: 90% Stun Resistance, +70% Movement Speed, 100% Water Current Resistance, +200% Melee Damage, +100% Melee Speed. Effect diminishes over time. Ride the Wind: While crouching, +300% Melee Speed, 80% Damage Resistance. Leaf Concealment: When health is below 50% while crouching, gain Concealment. Enemies cannot detect you.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_Gauss_Benzoyl_Per: Benzoyl Peroxide's exclusive weapon, from S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2. infotexts.entitydescription.deep_pigcat_three_shot: Jiazi's exclusive weapon, from GTFO. A large-caliber shotgun with three barrels. Its exaggerated projectile design and recoil that completely disregards the wrist seem to indicate this weapon exists solely to tear apart enemies in front of it. Numerous dents and scratches on the exterior speak of past hellish combat environments, but the internal structure is surprisingly well-maintained, without any signs of operational issues. Garganta is a nightmare of the past, but now, can I entrust my life to you once more? ‖color:gui.red‖(Gain 100 experience points and 20 Marks for each enemy killed with this shotgun.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 10, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 1, -40% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_three_mag: Exclusive magazine for the Triple-Barrel Shotgun. infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m79: An old grenade launcher, holding one 40mm grenade. Requires reloading after each shot. A good choice against swarm tactics. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 5, Damage Multiplier: 2, -30% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_gl40: The GL40 fires 40x46mm grenades. To load, the barrel swings to the left, exposing the breech. Besides the standard leaf sight, various sights and scopes can be attached via Picatinny rails on the sides and top. Highly portable. This version comes with a grip for standalone firing. ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1.5)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m32: The M32 revolving grenade launcher is a 6-shot, semi-automatic launcher. Combat rate of fire is 6 rounds / 3 seconds. Extremely high burst firepower for saturation bombardment of enemies. (Reload: 8s, Spread: 12, Damage Multiplier: 2, Rate of Fire: 0.5, 6-round cylinder)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_xm25: The XM25 airburst grenade weapon fires 25mm electronic fuze grenades. The fire control system can be programmed to detonate the grenade in the air above the target, providing greater area-of-effect lethality than traditional grenades. Deals massive damage to enemies behind cover. ‖color:gui.red‖(Programmable wall-breaching grenade, a huge threat to enemies behind walls and cover)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Firing Mode: Semi-Auto)‖end‖ (Reload: 3s, Spread: 12, Damage Multiplier: 1.5, Rate of Fire: 1.5s)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_xm25_abhe_mag: Contains 8 rounds of special wall-breaching airburst grenades for the XM25. Can penetrate walls and then airburst. ‖color:gui.red‖(Programmable wall-breaching grenade, a huge threat to enemies behind walls and cover)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_40mmgrenade_he: 40mm high-explosive grenade. Short fuse, lower damage compared to other grenades. Fire from a safe distance. ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Shrapnel Residue resistance‖end‖ (Armor Penetration: 0.5, Instant Fuse)

infotexts.entitydescription.steel_plate_arm: Small plate specifically for arm protection. Can be installed in body armor with corresponding slots. (Steel plates never break, but are heavy) (-30% Damage Taken, -30% Bleeding, -30% Stun, -30% Shrapnel Residue) (-10 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.steel_plate_groin: Small plate specifically for groin protection. Can be installed in body armor with corresponding slots. (Steel plates never break, but are heavy) (-30% Damage Taken, -30% Bleeding, -30% Stun, -30% Shrapnel Residue) (-5 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.steel_plate_1: Ballistic plate made from steel bars. Light steel defends against ‖color:gui.red‖Lead Low-Penetration Rounds‖end‖ damage. Poor resistance against armor-piercing ammunition. (Steel plates never break, but are heavy) (-30% Damage Taken, -30% Bleeding, -30% Stun, -30% Shrapnel Residue) (-20% Movement Speed, -10 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.steel_plate_2: Double-layer plate made from higher-performance Grade 45 steel. Provides good ballistic protection against ‖color:gui.red‖Titanium Bullets‖end‖. Downside is greater sacrifice in mobility. "With our current technology, we can only improve ballistic protection by adding more material. It's a reluctant necessity..." (Steel plates never break, but are heavy) (-60% Damage Taken, -60% Bleeding, -60% Stun, -60% Shrapnel Residue) (-40% Movement Speed, -20 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.steel_plate_3: Steel plate made from 3 layers of extreme-protection heavy armor steel. Completely sacrifices mobility for extreme protection. One of the few plates that can face ‖color:gui.red‖Physicorium Ammunition‖end‖ directly. (Steel plates never break, but are heavy) (-80% Damage Taken, -80% Bleeding, -80% Stun, -80% Shrapnel Residue) (-80% Movement Speed, -40 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.ceramics_plate_1: Ceramic plate primarily made of alumina. Alumina has higher density, lower hardness, is easy to process, and cheap. Very suitable for entry-level ceramic plates. (Ceramic plates absorb damage; character takes no damage before shattering. Requires repair after breaking.) (Absorbs ‖color:gui.red‖100‖end‖ damage before shattering. Plate is broken when the ‖color:gui.red‖health bar stops pulsing‖end‖.) (-30% Stun, Bleeding, Shrapnel Residue) (-10% Movement Speed, -10 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.ceramics_plate_2: Ceramic plate primarily made of silicon carbide. Silicon carbide has medium density, medium hardness, and a moderate price increase. Good cost-performance ratio, very suitable for mid-tier ceramic plates. (Ceramic plates absorb damage; character takes no damage before shattering. Requires repair after breaking.) (Absorbs ‖color:gui.red‖200‖end‖ damage before shattering. Plate is broken when the ‖color:gui.red‖health bar stops pulsing‖end‖.) (-60% Stun, Bleeding, Shrapnel Residue) (-10% Movement Speed, -10 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.ceramics_plate_3: Ceramic plate primarily made of boron carbide. Boron carbide has low density, high hardness. Downside is difficult processing and high price. Low cost-performance ratio, but provides high-level protection. (Ceramic plates absorb damage; character takes no damage before shattering. Requires repair after breaking.) (Absorbs ‖color:gui.red‖300‖end‖ damage before shattering. Plate is broken when the ‖color:gui.red‖health bar stops pulsing‖end‖.) (-80% Stun, Bleeding, Shrapnel Residue) (-10% Movement Speed, -10 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_nylon: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Nylon is the first synthetic fiber to be industrially produced by humans, widely used in textiles, machinery, electrical, and other fields.
infotexts.entitydescription.KEVLAR: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Kevlar fiber features low density, high strength, good toughness, high temperature resistance, easy processing and shaping. Density is only one-fifth of steel. Generally used for making body armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_carbon_fiber: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Carbon fiber is a high-strength fiber material composed of carbon atom bundles with a carbon content of over 90%. It is widely used in the manufacture of mid-range equipment and weapons. The Deep Diving Armory fabricator provides the corresponding recipe.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_pbo_fiber: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ PBO fiber is mainly used for heat-resistant industrial textiles and fiber-reinforced materials. It is a super fiber with high heat resistance and tensile strength, surpassing carbon fiber. Its overall performance is better than Dyneema fiber, but it is also heavier. The Coalition possesses a complete PBO fiber production base, which is one of the reasons for their strength.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_dyneema: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ Dyneema is an Ultra-High-Molecular-Weight Polyethylene fiber, widely used in protective products. This fiber is 15 times stronger than steel wire and lighter than water. Its physical strength far exceeds Kevlar fiber, but it is expensive to produce.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_high_hardness_cer: ‖color:gui.red‖(Craft at Deep Diving Armory Fabricator)‖end‖ The core protective material for ceramic plates. Its honeycomb design absorbs bullet impact well, and can be easily replaced after damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_assistant: Who knows what you'll get? Take a gamble, turn your bicycle into a motorbike!
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_materials_crate: Deep Diving Armory special materials crate, specifically designed to store a large amount of materials. It is waterproof and fireproof, and floats in water. ‖color:gui.red‖(Supports Item IO, Item Container)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_crate: Deep Diving Armory special plate crate, suitable for storing a large number of ballistic plates.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_weapon_container: Deep Diving Armory special weapon crate, specifically designed to store a large number of weapons.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_trash_can: Deep Diving Armory special trash can, specifically designed to dispose of annoying junk. (Place using Right Mouse Button + E)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_thermal_interfere: Highly encrypted enemy tactical device. Wear it to block thermal imaging. Unfortunately, we cannot crack its internal permissions.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_reinforce_transmi: "You completed the mission ahead of schedule? Very good! If you're still not satisfied, try this beacon. Deep Diving Armory welcomes every diver who challenges the limits." ‖color:gui.green‖(Use with Right-click + Left-click to summon additional enemies. Extra enemies grant rich rewards.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Do not throw into trash can or delete.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ammo_container: Deep Diving Armory special ammo crate, specifically designed to store a large amount of ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_accessory_contain: Deep Diving Armory special accessory crate. No, not computer accessories.
Deep Diving Armory special accessory crate. No, not computer accessories.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_explosive_contain: Deep Diving Armory special explosives crate. Prepare to blast the enemy to the surface.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_cloth_container: Deep Diving Armory special wardrobe. The Deep Diving Home, every crew member's choice. (Place using Right Mouse Button + E)
infotexts.entitydescription.turtle_soup: Incomparably delicious turtle soup. Made with aged female turtles as the base. Drinking it increases FPS by 3 times, freeing you from server rollback torture (fantasy).
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_cloth_invisible: Clothing hider developed by Deep Diving Armory. Very useful when you need to appreciate your clothes. ‖color:gui.red‖(Place equipment inside to hide the texture when worn on character)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Equip the hider, place hidden equipment inside, press the button to restore texture)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(If invisible equipment is dropped on the ground, verify using ALT key)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_pirate_exosuit: An exosuit privately modified by pirates. Added extra Aramid plates to prevent shrapnel residue. ‖color:gui.red‖(Pirate exosuit never breaks, but mobility is poor)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms, Thighs, Shins, Feet)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.9)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖
infotexts.charactername.deep_pigcat_team_moonwolf: 'Deep Diving Squad' Shadow Moon Azure Wolf
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_destory_pirate_b: "Pirate activity has increased recently. According to reconnaissance reports, pirate traces have been found at [location1]. Nearby fleets are summoned for elimination. The Coalition will rebuild the outpost. Do not destroy the outpost with ship turrets; violators will be severely punished! You must nip this pirate site in the bud before it develops further. The Europa Coalition will not be stingy with rewards for fleets completing the mission. Move out, nearby fleets!" ‖color:gui.green‖(Combat Zone mission: Can redock to engage enemies, but beware of vanilla mission enemies rushing your sub)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖PigCat Senpai support chance‖end‖: 50% ‖color:gui.red‖Enemy Intel‖end‖: 8 hostiles: 1 Leader, 2 Soldiers, 2 Assault Troopers, 3 Recruits. ‖color:gui.red‖Multiplayer Intel‖end‖: Adds 1 additional heavy. ‖color:gui.red‖One wave of reinforcements will arrive after all initial hostiles are killed. A second, stronger wave will arrive 20 minutes after the mission starts.‖end‖ Equipped with WW2 weapons + low penetration ammo. A few wear body armor (no plates) + ballistic helmets. ‖color:gui.red‖Do not use ship turrets.‖end‖
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_destory_pirate_base_: "Not a single pirate left. Well done. Here is your reward."
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_destory_pirate_base_: "Re-summoning new fleets to eliminate the pirates. Erase the names of the previously failed fleets. We can't tarnish the Coalition's reputation; this is crucial for us."
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_destory_pirate_base: "Good work everyone. Take a moment to rest, then we move out."
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_destory_pirate_b: "According to the latest intelligence, a pirate site has been discovered at [location1]. Nearby fleets are summoned for elimination. The Coalition will rebuild the outpost. Do not destroy the outpost with ship turrets; violators will be severely punished! This site is a pirate relay station. Destroy it. The Europa Coalition will not be stingy with rewards for fleets completing the mission. Move out, nearby fleets!" ‖color:gui.green‖(Combat Zone mission: Can redock to engage enemies, but beware of vanilla mission enemies rushing your sub)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖PigCat Senpai support chance‖end‖: 50% ‖color:gui.red‖Enemy Intel (Additional elite enemies appear in multiplayer)‖end‖: 6 hostiles: 2 Leaders, 2 Renegade Soldiers, 2 Assault Troopers. ‖color:gui.red‖Multiplayer Intel‖end‖: Adds 3 additional elite enemies. ‖color:gui.red‖One wave of reinforcements will arrive after all initial hostiles are killed. A second, stronger wave will arrive 20 minutes after the mission starts.‖end‖ Most use steel firearms, including rifles, sniper rifles, shotguns. Most equipped with body armor (no plates) + ballistic helmets. ‖color:gui.red‖Do not use ship turrets.‖end‖
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_destory_pirate_base_: "Pirate site cleared. Well done. Here is your reward."
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_destory_pirate_base_: "Re-summoning new fleets to eliminate the pirates. Erase the names of the previously failed fleets. We can't tarnish the Coalition's reputation; this is crucial for us."
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_destory_pirate_base: "Good work everyone. Check ammo and medical supplies. Take a moment to rest, then we move out."
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_destory_pirate_b: "According to the latest intelligence, a long-established pirate fortress has been discovered at [location1]. Nearby fleets are summoned for elimination. The Coalition will rebuild the outpost. Do not destroy the outpost with ship turrets; violators will be severely punished! This site is the pirates' main nest. Destroy it to weaken the nearby pirate forces. The Europa Coalition will not be stingy with rewards for fleets completing the mission. Move out, nearby fleets!" ‖color:gui.green‖(Combat Zone mission: Can redock to engage enemies, but beware of vanilla mission enemies rushing your sub)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖PigCat Senpai support chance‖end‖: 50% ‖color:gui.red‖Enemy Intel (Additional elite enemies appear in multiplayer)‖end‖: 6 hostiles: 1 Leader, 2 Heavy Defenders, 2 Renegade Soldiers, 1 Assault Trooper. ‖color:gui.red‖Multiplayer Intel‖end‖: Adds 3 additional elite enemies. ‖color:gui.red‖One wave of reinforcements will arrive after all initial hostiles are killed. A second, stronger wave will arrive 20 minutes after the mission starts.‖end‖ Most use steel firearms. Beware of their large caliber weapons, possibly anti-materiel rifles. Most equipped with body armor (with plates) + ballistic helmets, some equipped with exoskeletons. ‖color:gui.red‖Do not use ship turrets.‖end‖
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_destory_pirate_base_: "Pirate nest cleared. Well done. Here is your reward."
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_destory_pirate_base_: "Re-summoning new fleets to eliminate the pirates. Erase the names of the previously failed fleets. We can't tarnish the Coalition's reputation; this is crucial for us."
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_destory_pirate_base: "Good work everyone. Check ammo and medical supplies. We need to rest for a while."
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_mine_saltpeter_m: Saltpeter deposits are rumored to be located in the passage between [location1] and [location2]. It's one of the essential raw materials for making gunpowder. Please bring back 8 saltpeter samples to verify the mineral deposit.
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_mine_saltpeter_mine: Sufficient saltpeter samples have been mined. Return them to the outpost for payment.
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_mine_saltpeter_miner: Your efforts confirm the presence of saltpeter.
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_mine_sulfur_mine: Sulfur deposits are rumored to be located in the passage between [location1] and [location2]. It's one of the essential raw materials for making gunpowder. Please bring back 8 sulfur samples to verify the mineral deposit.
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_mine_sulfur_mineral: Sufficient sulfur samples have been mined. Return them to the outpost for payment.
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_mine_sulfur_mineral: Your efforts confirm the presence of sulfur.
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_clear_wreck: "We recently lost contact with a transport ship. Go check the situation. We won't let you run errands for nothing."
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_clear_wreck: "So it was the Thalamus's doing. Looks like we need to develop new herbicides."
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_clear_husk_beaco: "Captain, sonar shows an abandoned beacon station nearby. Horrifying sounds are coming from inside... Maybe Crawlers?" "Ready your weapons. Let's go check it out. I heard this story countless times as a child. There are no Crawlers on Europa."
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_clear_husk_beacon: Crawlers don't exist. Hearing strange noises on Europa? Husks are more likely.
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_clear_husk_ruin: "Strange noises are coming from the usually silent ruins! Follow Europa Radio Broadcast to uncover the truth."
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_clear_husk_ruin: "I don't like these kinds of broadcasts. They're just exaggerating to attract attention."
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_beacon_fight_pir: ‖color:gui.red‖To Modder: If you want to fix the generation bug with wrecktags and beacontags, check out the Wrecktags And Beacontags Bug Fix mod.‖end‖ "One of our beacon stations has been illegally occupied by pirates. They stole weapons from Coalition fleets. Go eliminate those bastards and activate the beacon station!" "Retaking the beacon station will be a great help in establishing our outpost." ‖color:gui.green‖(The enemy leader has a hard drive. Don't forget to activate the beacon station.)‖end‖
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_beacon_fight_pirate_: "The beacon station is back online. Well done. Nearby outposts will be grateful."
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_beacon_fight_pirate_: Failed to activate the beacon. The pirates have left this station but remain at large in this area.
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_beacon_fight_pir: ‖color:gui.red‖To Modder: If you want to fix the generation bug with wrecktags and beacontags, check out the Wrecktags And Beacontags Bug Fix mod.‖end‖ "According to fleet intel, the Pirate King has been spotted in this shipping lane. He has likely taken over the beacon station as a temporary stop. The Pirate King has been at large for a while. It's time to put an end to him!" "Retaking the beacon station will be a great help in establishing our outpost." ‖color:gui.green‖(The enemy leader has a hard drive. Don't forget to activate the beacon station.)‖end‖
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_beacon_fight_pirate_: "The beacon station is back online. Well done. Nearby outposts will be grateful."
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_beacon_fight_pirate_: Failed to activate the beacon. The pirates have left this station but remain at large in this area.
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_beacon_fight_1: Enemy beacon station detected. Prepare for boarding action!
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_beacon_fight_2: "The Separatists have successfully captured one of our Kättingrad outposts. This outpost serves a crucial role as a supply station in the center of the route. We must retake it!" ‖color:gui.red‖(The Separatists obtained the Coalition's classified hard drive. Maybe check their safe?)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Please do not accept pirate ship elimination missions simultaneously, it may cause bugs.)‖end‖
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_beacon_fight_2: Enemy outpost detected. Prepare for boarding action!
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_f1: F1 heavy grenade, nicknamed "Big Lemon". Cast iron body, weighs 600g, contains 60g TNT explosive. Effective kill radius approx. 30 meters. Short throwing distance, extremely powerful fragmentation effect. After throwing, run as far away as possible. ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Shrapnel Residue resistance‖end‖ (Press E to cook) (4s fuse, Short throw distance, Large explosion radius)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m67: M67 fragmentation grenade, standard issue for Coalition forces. Very large explosion radius, fragments remain lethal to distant enemies. ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Shrapnel Residue resistance‖end‖ (Press E to cook) (5s fuse, Medium throw distance, Very large explosion radius)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m18: M18 smoke grenade. Quickly releases smoke after throwing, covering friendly retreat. (Press E to cook) (2s fuse, Medium throw distance, Small explosion radius) ‖color:gui.red‖(Standing in smoke: Gain 50% Gunshot Wound & Headshot Resistance, +25% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Smoke duration: 15s)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_RGD5: RGD-5 offensive grenade, standard issue for Separatists. Smaller explosion radius, shorter fuse. Belongs to offensive grenades. ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Shrapnel Residue resistance‖end‖ (Press E to cook) (2s fuse, Medium throw distance, Small explosion radius)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_RGO: RGO impact grenade. Features an impact fuse for instant detonation. This grenade is prone to friendly fire, maintain safe distance. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Since the RGO fuse requires a certain force to arm, you can theoretically catch it in mid-air and throw it back)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Hold Left Mouse Button to throw‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Shrapnel Residue resistance‖end‖ (Impact fuse, Long throw distance, Very small explosion radius)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_Cluster: A grenade made by bundling multiple grenades together. Simultaneous explosion of several grenades delivers devastating impact, but note the very short throwing distance. ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Shrapnel Residue resistance‖end‖ (Press E to cook) (8s fuse, Very short throw distance, Very large explosion radius, Devastating explosion)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m24: A relatively old stick grenade. Cheap to produce, its special shape allows for long throwing distance. Explosion radius is smaller compared to other grenades. ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Shrapnel Residue resistance‖end‖ (Press E to cook) (2s fuse, Very long throw distance, Small explosion radius)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_claymore: Point "THIS SIDE TOWARDS ENEMY" towards the likely direction of enemy approach, find a quiet corner, and wait for the enemy to be blown to pieces! Blue laser indicates friendly claymore, red indicates hostile. This claymore only detects Deep Diving human enemies, not vanilla hostile humans or monsters. Suitable for combat zones. ‖color:gui.green‖This is a right-facing claymore, use the button to switch direction.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Shrapnel Residue resistance‖end‖ (Press E to place or disarm) ‖color:gui.red‖(Flip the switch to arm. Do not remove the Claymore from inventory while the switch is on.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Do not place under character's feet when arming. Maintain safe distance when disarming.)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(For your safety, do not arm the Claymore while running.)‖end‖ (Small explosion radius, High lethality)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_claymore_left_ene: Enemy claymore with IFF. Watch your step, this little thing has taken too many lives... This claymore only detects humans, not monsters. ‖color:gui.green‖(Please modify into a Friendly Claymore before use)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ied: An improvised explosive made from C4. Throw it out, then dial the phone to detonate. Don't underestimate it; its explosive yield can launch a car into the sky. ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Shrapnel Residue resistance‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can stick to anything)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can only be detonated by IED Remote)‖end‖ (Short throw distance, Small explosion radius, Extremely high lethality)

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ied_remote: Beep beep beep! Boom!!! ‖color:gui.red‖(Can detonate all nearby IEDs not in inventory)‖end‖

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_stun_grenade: Non-lethal grenade. Provides better control effect than conventional flashbangs. Mixed with graphite powder for an EMP effect. Ideal for apprehending enemies. ‖color:gui.green‖Go Prone: Hold Spacebar to go prone, gaining 90% Stun & Flash resistance‖end‖ (Press E to cook) (2s fuse, Medium throw distance, Medium explosion radius)
infotexts.eventtext.deep_reinforce_end.c1: "Don't let your guard down, more enemies are about to enter the outpost. Prepare to engage!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_reinforce_end.c1: "Deep Diving Squad 2 'Heavy Blasters' ready. Let's show them our hospitality."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_reinforce_end_team: "Calling outpost, calling outpost. This is Deep Diving Squad 3 'Assault Team', preparing to enter outpost. Adopting Tactic A."
"The veterans of Deep Diving Squad 4 are joining the battlefield. Prepare to engage."
"Deep Diving Squad 5 'Breachers'. Can this fleet withstand this wave?"
"Deep Diving Squad 6 'Fire Support Team', arrived at the battlefield. Buy me a drink after the exercise."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_reinforce_complete: "Congratulations! You have completed Operation Abyssal Silence. But the story of Deep Diving Armory has just begun. After this battle, Deep Diving Armory will be established as a company to provide services to more divers." "But before that, let's celebrate!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pirate_reinforce_20min.c1: "According to Coalition intel, enemy pirate reinforcements will join the battle in 20 minutes. End this quickly!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pirate_reinforce_20min.c2: "Sir, enemy reinforcements are 10 seconds out from the outpost!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_separatists_reinforce_20m: "Separatist reinforcements will join the battle in 20 minutes. End this quickly!"
"Sir, the main Separatist force is 10 seconds out from the outpost!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_coalition_reinforce_20min: "Coalition reinforcements will join the battle in 20 minutes. End this quickly!"
"Sir, the main Coalition force is 10 seconds out from the outpost!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_ghost_reinforce_20min.c1: "Listen up, Separatist forces! The Coalition has sent another elite Ghost Squad as reinforcements. Eliminate them within 20 minutes!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_ghost_reinforce_20min.c2: "The veteran Ghost Squad is 10 seconds from joining the fight. Retreat now!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_grizzlies_reinforce_20min: "This is the Grizzly Squad Captain. Comrades holding the outpost, hang on! We will arrive to support you in 15 minutes!"
"The legendary Grizzly Squad Captain is 10 seconds from joining the fight. Retreat now!"
"I've received orders from the Deep Diving Armory's armed department to support my juniors. I will join the battle in 3 minutes!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcatman_reinforce.c1: "Alright, bring it on! Bullets to the chest! (Pre-battle cry)"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_beacon_fight_pirate.c1: "Listen up, fleet that accepted this mission. You need to eliminate the pirates inside the beacon station and activate it. Be careful not to destroy the station. My order is to retake the station, not destroy it." "Watch out for the pirates inside. They are well-equipped and ruthless. Don't hesitate for a moment. Pull the trigger!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_easy.mine: "Running a bit low on gunpowder lately."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_easy.mine2: "There's a Saltpeter and Sulfur deposit nearby. Go dig up 10, or maybe 9 of them."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_easy.money: "Running a bit short on cash lately."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_easy.wangdao: "Looks like it's the royal road for me after all..."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_easy.c1: "Hello, this is Deep Diving Armory PigCat Squad, offering royal road missions."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_medium.mine: "Running a bit low on gunpowder lately."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_medium.mine2: "There's a Saltpeter and Sulfur deposit nearby. Go dig up 10, or maybe 9 of them."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_medium.money: "Running a bit short on cash lately."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_medium.wangdao: "Looks like it's the royal road for me after all..."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_medium.c1: "Hello, this is Deep Diving Armory PigCat Squad, offering royal road missions."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_contract_room_star: "Hello, this is your primary contact for the Deep Diving Armory — codename 'PigCat Senpai'. Welcome to the combat zone! I am here to provide briefings. If you have any questions, feel free to ask me at any time."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_contract_room_opti: "Why is it you again? Are there no other employees at Deep Diving Armory?"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_contract_room.cont: "Deep Diving Contracts are a difficulty feedback system introduced by Deep Diving Armory. We will assess your combat performance based on the contracts you choose, and distribute materials and rewards accordingly. The more contracts you accept, the greater the rewards, but the difficulty will also ramp up. Select contracts carefully based on your capabilities!"
infotexts.eventtext.deep_pigcat_contract_room.xian: "Anyone can be referred to as a senior. Whether it's the ones you meet at outposts or those arriving as reinforcements, they all share the codename 'PigCat Senpai'. Besides, Deep Diving Armory is still in its early stages of public listing, so we are indeed short-staffed. The boss is still actively recruiting more personnel (sadly)."
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_destory_separati: "Damn Separatists seized our outpost! These separatists are a plague on Europa! According to the last communication from the site, the main Separatist force has been eliminated, leaving behind regular soldiers. Your mission is to take them out and regain control of the outpost. Separatists are formally trained military, unlike those pirates. Proceed with caution." ‖color:gui.green‖(Combat Zone mission: Can redock to engage enemies, but beware of vanilla mission enemies rushing your sub)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Enemy Intel (Additional elite enemies appear in multiplayer)‖end‖: 6 hostiles: 1 Soldier, 1 Striker, 2 Heavy Defenders, 1 Sniper, 1 Grenadier. ‖color:gui.red‖Multiplayer Intel‖end‖: Adds 4 additional elite enemies. ‖color:gui.red‖One wave of reinforcements will arrive after all initial hostiles are killed. A second, stronger wave will arrive 20 minutes after the mission starts.‖end‖ Use rifles, shotguns, SMGs, sniper rifles, grenade launchers. All equipped with body armor (with plates) + ballistic helmets. Some enemies have Tier 2 plates. ‖color:gui.red‖Do not use ship turrets.‖end‖

"Intel indicates: The main Separatist force has occupied a Coalition site. As a Separatist army, they are no match for those pirates. Prepare thoroughly. I have a bad feeling about this..." ‖color:gui.green‖(Combat Zone mission: Can redock to engage enemies, but beware of vanilla mission enemies rushing your sub)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Enemy Intel (Additional elite enemies appear in multiplayer)‖end‖: 6 hostiles: Leader, Blaster, Sniper, Heavy Defender, Striker, Grenadier. ‖color:gui.red‖Multiplayer Intel‖end‖: Adds 4 additional elite enemies. ‖color:gui.red‖One wave of reinforcements will arrive after all initial hostiles are killed. A second, stronger wave will arrive 20 minutes after the mission starts.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Do not use ship turrets.‖end‖
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_destory_grizzlie: "Captain, we have successfully taken the area. Coalition reinforcements have all been eliminated." "Those Coalition bastards are really stubborn. Count ammo and personnel, we're moving to the next site." "But before that, another sub has docked at the outpost. Prepare to welcome our guests, soldiers. It's time to give them a proper 'reception'!" ‖color:gui.green‖(Combat Zone mission: Can redock to engage enemies, but beware of vanilla mission enemies rushing your sub)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Enemy Intel (Additional elite enemies appear in multiplayer)‖end‖: 6 hostiles. ‖color:gui.red‖Multiplayer Intel‖end‖: Adds 4 additional elite enemies. ‖color:gui.red‖One wave of reinforcements will arrive after all initial hostiles are killed. A second, stronger wave will arrive 20 minutes after the mission starts.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Warning: This mission is extremely difficult. As the highest difficulty in Deep Diving, engage with caution.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Do not use ship turrets.‖end‖
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_destory_pigcatte: "Deep Diving Squad is in position. Attention all fleets participating in the Deep Diving Armory exercise: you will face the Deep Diving Squad at their peak combat potential!" "Fleets that successfully complete the exercise will receive rich rewards! Don't mind the severed limbs and blood on the ground; they are just simulated by the system. This is only a drill, no one will get hurt." "Today is also the founding day of Deep Diving Armory. PigCat Senpai will be here to welcome you. Welcome all fleets to join the celebration!" ‖color:gui.green‖(Combat Zone mission: Can redock to engage enemies, but beware of vanilla mission enemies rushing your sub)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Enemy Intel‖end‖: 10 hostiles. ‖color:gui.red‖One wave of reinforcements will arrive after all initial hostiles are killed. Total 5 waves of reinforcements.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Warning: Hopeless Difficulty — DO NOT ANSWER —‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Do not use ship turrets.‖end‖
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_destory_coalitio: "The Coalition forces just seized one of our outposts. We must prevent them from establishing a military blockade here! The Separatists are the future of Europa!" ‖color:gui.green‖(Combat Zone mission: Can redock to engage enemies, but beware of vanilla mission enemies rushing your sub)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Enemy Intel (Additional elite enemies appear in multiplayer)‖end‖: 6 hostiles. ‖color:gui.red‖Multiplayer Intel‖end‖: Adds 4 additional elite enemies. ‖color:gui.red‖One wave of reinforcements will arrive after all initial hostiles are killed. A second, stronger wave will arrive 20 minutes after the mission starts.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Do not use ship turrets.‖end‖
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_destory_ghost_ba: The GHOST Squad, the Coalition's covert infiltration unit, excels in stealth and assassination. Their CQB capabilities are also on par with Separatist forces. "The Coalition sent the Ghost Squad to capture this outpost. Our garrison and reinforcements were wiped out. This outpost is extremely important to the Separatists. We must retake it." "I am the commander of the Separatist forces. I've heard about your fleet's past victories against Coalition troops. We can only rely on you now. Upon success, you will be handsomely rewarded." "For the future of Europa!" ‖color:gui.green‖(Combat Zone mission: Can redock to engage enemies, but beware of vanilla mission enemies rushing your sub)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Warning: This mission is extremely difficult. Ensure you have successfully completed Coalition Hard missions before attempting this.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Enemy Intel (Additional elite enemies appear in multiplayer)‖end‖: 6 hostiles. ‖color:gui.red‖Multiplayer Intel‖end‖: Adds 4 additional elite enemies. ‖color:gui.red‖One wave of reinforcements will arrive after all initial hostiles are killed. A second, stronger wave will arrive 20 minutes after the mission starts.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Do not use ship turrets.‖end‖
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_destory_ghost_base_h: "The Ghost Squad is wiped out! This is a major blow to the Coalition!"
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_destory_ghost_base_h: "Damn it, looks like we have to cede this outpost to those Coalition bastards..."
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_destory_grizzlies_ba: "Confiscate their equipment. We're moving on to the next Coalition site."
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_destory_grizzlies_b: "The once-invincible Grizzly Squad has suffered a major blow."
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_destory_pigcatteam_n: "Exercise complete. Remember to wipe off the artificial blood, and head to the Quartermaster for your rewards."
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_destory_pigcatteam_n: "We regret that your fleet did not pass the Deep Diving assessment. It's okay, there's always next time."
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_destory_pigcatteam_: "You passed the opening ceremony? Very good. Time to heat things up!"
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_destory_separatist_b: "The Separatists successfully captured the outpost. Their influence is growing daily."
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_destory_coalition_ba: "We succeeded! Those Coalition bastards are all dead!"
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_destory_coalition_ba: "The Coalition forces captured the outpost, but we will return."
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m2_turret: A small turret equipped with an M2 heavy machine gun. The M2 HMG uses conventional ammunition and does not require supercapacitors to fire. Uses 12.7x99mm rounds. Combined with a rate of fire of 500 RPM, it provides effective suppression against small monsters.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m2_loader: Can load different ammunition types for the M2 heavy machine gun.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m2_ammobox_cheap: Cheap ammunition for the M2 HMG. Produced in large quantities by reducing bullet mass, propellant charge, etc. (Ammo Count: 300, very suitable for dealing with small targets)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m2_ammobox_tit: Standard ammunition for the M2 HMG. Smaller quantity per box, but each round has high damage and armor penetration. (Ammo Count: 150, very suitable for dealing with elite targets)
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_in_water: Triggers penalty mechanism when enemies are in water. Immune to pressure, hypoxia, general damage. Takes 3x shrapnel residue damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_nuclear_battery: Nuclear battery developed by Deep Diving Armory. Lightweight and compact, provides infinite power to electrical devices.
infotexts.entitydescription.gssh01_headset: Standard issue headset for Separatist soldiers. Longer communication range than standard headsets, includes auto-injection function. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Incompatible with heavy helmets)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Auxiliary upgrades)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.m32_headset: Coalition tactical headset. Better communication signal, includes auto-injection. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Incompatible with heavy helmets)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Auxiliary upgrades)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_suit_invisible_he: Special headset released by Deep Diving Armory. Can hide Deep Diving equipment, perfectly displaying your exquisite clothing. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Hides Deep Diving Armory equipment)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Auxiliary upgrades)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.walker_headset: Walker headset features smart injection function, accurately controlling the dosage needed to treat wounds, preventing opioid addiction. Also has a long communication range. ‖color:gui.orange‖(Incompatible with heavy helmets)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Auxiliary upgrades)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_learn: By incorporating extensive textbook content into the chip, educational material is played cyclically when the user wears the headset, greatly benefiting the wearer. (+100% Skill Gain Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_learn_2: You strive for excellence in learning your skills and have achieved good results. (+200% Skill Gain Speed) (All skills will not be lower than 60)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_learn_3: "Learning is endless; the sea of knowledge is boundless." (+300% Skill Gain Speed) (All skills will not be lower than 80) (Allows all skill levels to exceed 100)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_mechanical: Basics of Mechanical Engineering, 6th Edition textbook, published by Europa Industrial University. Teaches beginners mechanical engineering from scratch. (+100% Mechanical Engineering Skill Gain Speed, +30% Mechanical Device Repair Speed, +30% Hull Repair Speed, +30% Plasma Cutter Efficiency) (50% Water Current Resistance)
infotexts.entityname.chip_electrician: "Basics of Electrical and Electronic Engineering" Auxiliary Upgrade
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_electrician: Basics of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, 6th Edition textbook, published by Europa Industrial University. From beginner to burial. (+100% Electrical Engineering Skill Gain Speed, +50% Device Repair Speed, +30% Max Electrical Device Repair Condition, 50% Burn Resistance, 50% Electrical Shock Resistance) (50% Water Current Resistance)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_security: Published by Europa Military University. Contains the written procedures for training new recruits, helping you progress from rookie to qualified soldier. (+100% Weapon Handling Skill Gain Speed, +10% Speed, +10% Max Health, +20% Melee Damage & Speed, +20% Buff Duration, -20% Debuff Duration) (50% Water Current Resistance, -20% Spread, +10% Turret Fire Rate)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_security_2: After facing the monsters of the abyss and outpost enemies, you have achieved many merits and been promoted to Sergeant First Class. (+200% Weapon Handling Skill Gain Speed, +20% Speed, +20% Max Health, +40% Melee Damage & Speed, +40% Buff Duration, -40% Debuff Duration) (80% Water Current Resistance, -25% Spread, +15% Turret Fire Rate) (-50% Damage dealt to friendly targets, -20% Turret Power Consumption)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_captain: Operating a submarine on Europa is no easy task. This Navigation and Economic Management textbook can lend you a hand! ‖color:gui.red‖(Only effective for one person; disabled if multiple wearers)‖end‖ (+100% Helm Skill Gain Speed, +10% Reputation Gain, Mission Money Reward, Experience Gain) (+1 Max Mission Count, +3 Special Sale Items in Store, +10% Sell Price, -10% Buy Price)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_captain_2: As the leadership core, the captain's coordinated combat with the crew enhances their combat effectiveness. ‖color:gui.red‖(Only effective for one person; disabled if multiple wearers)‖end‖ (All nearby crew members gain: 10% Stun & Physical Damage Resistance, 10% Movement Speed, +10% Experience Gain) (+200% Helm Skill Gain Speed, +15% Reputation Gain, Mission Money Reward, Experience Gain) (+2 Max Mission Count, +6 Special Sale Items in Store, +15% Sell Price, -15% Buy Price)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_medic: 7th Edition textbook published by Europa Medical University. Diagnostics grants doctors the ability to make initial diagnoses of ailments. (+100% Medical Skill Gain Speed, +10% Run Speed, +20% Poison Effectiveness, +50% CPR Effectiveness) (+10% Gene Splicing Effectiveness, -50% Genetic Contamination Chance)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_medic_2: 7th Edition textbook published by Europa Medical University. Internal Medicine is a must-learn textbook for every doctor. (+200% Medical Skill Gain Speed, +20% Run Speed, +30% Poison Effectiveness, +70% CPR Effectiveness) (+20% Gene Splicing Effectiveness, -70% Genetic Contamination Chance)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_assistant: The gospel compiled by the Clown Matriarch, guiding clowns towards fun. (+50% Skill Gain Speed, +10% Speed, Gain Clown Power and Hypoxia Resistance) (Gain Psychosis)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_assistant_2: A classic work by the Master Prankster, teaching you how to attract others' attention (Master Prankster not responsible if you get beaten up). (+100% Skill Gain Speed, +20% Speed, Gain Clown Power and Hypoxia Resistance) (Gain Irritating Presence)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_mechanical_2: One of the essential study materials for every professional mechanic, bringing you the unique charm of mechanics. (Mechanical Engineering skill will not be lower than 55) (+200% Mechanical Engineering Skill Gain Speed, +50% Mechanical Device Repair Speed, +50% Hull Repair Speed, +50% Plasma Cutter Efficiency) (+50% Deconstructor Speed, +50% Fabricator Speed, +1 Item Crafting Quality) (80% Water Current Resistance)
infotexts.entityname.chip_mechanical_3: "Theory of Machines and Mechanisms and Their Applications" Auxiliary Upgrade
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_mechanical_3: Professional textbook published by Europa Industrial University. Thicker than a certain Earth dictionary. Fortunately, its content has been compressed into the headset. (Mechanical Engineering skill will not be lower than 90) (+300% Mechanical Engineering Skill Gain Speed, +100% Mechanical Device Repair Speed, +100% Hull Repair Speed, +100% Plasma Cutter Efficiency) (+200% Deconstructor Speed, +200% Fabricator Speed, +2 Item Crafting Quality) (+200% Damage dealt to Thalamus)
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_electrician_2: Essential textbook for professional engineers. Knowledge is power! (Electrical Engineering skill will not be lower than 55) (+200% Electrical Engineering Skill Gain Speed, +70% Device Repair Speed, 70% Burn Resistance, 70% Electrical Shock Resistance) (+50% Deconstructor Speed, +50% Fabricator Speed, +50% Max Electrical Device Repair Condition, +1 Item Crafting Quality) (80% Water Current Resistance)
infotexts.entityname.chip_electrician_3: "Electrical and Electronic Control Circuits" Auxiliary Upgrade
infotexts.entitydescription.chip_electrician_3: Textbook required for master engineers. Still published by our old alma mater, Europa Industrial University. Helping you get ashore! (Electrical Engineering skill will not be lower than 90) (+300% Electrical Engineering Skill Gain Speed, +100% Device Repair Speed, 90% Burn Resistance, 90% Electrical Shock Resistance) (+200% Deconstructor Speed, +200% Fabricator Speed, +100% Max Device Repair Condition, +2 Item Crafting Quality)
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_healmet_talent: Neural Adjustment connected. Insert different chips to activate different effects.
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_headset: Auxiliary Upgrade connected. Insert different chips to activate different effects.
infotexts.entitydescription.ore_refining_machine: Industrial-grade small ore refinery. Powered by nuclear battery, no wiring needed for refining process.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_refine_graphite: Highly purified graphite. Deconstructing yields more materials. Can also be sold at a high price.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_refine_diamond: Highly purified diamond. Deconstructing yields more materials. Can also be sold at a high price.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_refine_cryolite: Highly purified cryolite. Deconstructing yields more materials. Can also be sold at a high price.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_refine_pyromorphi: Highly purified pyromorphite. Deconstructing yields more materials. Can also be sold at a high price.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_refine_chrysopras: Highly purified chrysoprase. Deconstructing yields more materials. Can also be sold at a high price.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_refine_langbeinit: Highly purified langbeinite. Deconstructing yields more materials. Can also be sold at a high price.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_refine_saltpeter: Highly purified saltpeter. Deconstructing yields more materials. Can also be sold at a high price.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_refine_sulfur: Highly purified sulfur. Deconstructing yields more materials. Can also be sold at a high price.
infotexts.locationdescription.deep_mobile_city_typ: Typhoon-class mobile city. Its massive frame carries an entire city, navigating beneath Europa's ice.
infotexts.locationdescription.deep_outpost_fight: The enemy has captured this outpost. Requesting backup!
infotexts.locationchange.None.changeto.deep_mobile: Typhoon-class mobile city has moved to [previousname] and will make a brief stop.
Typhoon-class mobile city has departed from [previousname].
infotexts.locationchange.None.changeto.deep_outpos: [previousname] is attempting to establish an outpost, but it has been captured by the enemy.
infotexts.locationchange.deep_outpost_fight.change: [previousname] has cleared the remaining enemies with the help of the Typhoon fleet.
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_pistol_mozambique: When own health is below 50%, holding a pistol triggers Mozambique Drill: +50% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire.
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_sniper_heavy_aim: Controlling a heavy anti-materiel rifle isn't easy. Just picking it up consumes a lot of stamina. When health < 80%: -10% Damage, +30% Spread. When health < 50%: -20% Damage, +60% Spread. When health < 20%: -30% Damage, +90% Spread.
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_machinegun_shot: Recoil control is crucial to becoming a qualified machine gunner. -70% Spread when crouching while holding a machine gun.
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_wuchuan: When the Wuchuan (Dark Wind) rises, retreat to survive, advance to conquer. Can block with the blade, or dash forward like the wind. Right-click to charge stance. Enemy attacks on Wuchuan accelerate the charge. When the charge bar is full, activate Swift Step (Sata). Swift Step: 90% Stun Resistance, +70% Movement Speed, 100% Water Current Resistance, +200% Melee Damage, +100% Melee Speed. Effect diminishes over time. Ride the Wind: While crouching, +300% Melee Speed, 80% Damage Resistance. Leaf Concealment: When health is below 50% while crouching, gain Concealment. Enemies cannot detect you.
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_talent_all: (Collection of all Deep Diving Armory talents, consolidated into one talent to reduce lag.) ‖color:gui.red‖Deep Diving Armory's changes to combat: Bullets have a 60% chance to pass through both arms and deal damage to the torso, alleviating the issue of "steel arms" (as vanilla arms have a 50% damage reduction). All shields will not push targets but will block bullets, providing a better tactical experience.‖end‖ Deep Diving Armory's unique numerical balance: Vanilla and other modded firearms deal 4x headshot damage and +30% gun damage when not in water. You can use firearms from other mods in combat. ‖color:gui.red‖When using Deep Diving weapons to attack other creatures, if either party is in the water, a water resistance damage reduction will trigger, dealing only 50% damage (this can be offset by installing "Underwater Drag Optimization").‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Deep Diving guns deal only 10% damage when attacking behemoths; creatures with a mass ≥ 3000 are determined to be behemoths.‖end‖ Lethal Headshot is a crucial mechanic in Deep Diving combat, allowing you to cheese high-tier enemies with low-tier weapons. Lethal Headshot only affects humans and is ineffective against other creatures.
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_chip_talent: Weapon Upgrade connected. Insert different chips to activate different effects.
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_melee_talent: Dagger Usage Guide: Assassinate enemies in smoke.
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_armor_talent: Armor Upgrade connected. Insert different chips to activate different effects.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_knife: Tactical dagger made from titanium-aluminum alloy. Can be used for close-quarters combat or assassination missions. ‖color:gui.red‖(Attacking enemies in smoke performs an execution: 20x Melee Damage Bonus, -50% Attack Speed)‖end‖
infotexts.talentdescription.deep_headshot_3x_balan: Unique numerical balance for Deep Diving Armory. Vanilla and other modded firearms deal 4x headshot damage and +30% gun damage when not in water. You can use firearms from other mods in combat. When in water, Deep Diving firearms suffer -60% damage due to water resistance (can be offset by installing "Underwater Drag Optimization"). Lethal Headshot is a crucial mechanic in Deep Diving combat. You can use low-tier weapons to cheese high-tier enemies. Lethal Headshot only applies to humans not in water, ineffective against other creatures.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_carrier: A plate carrier without ballistic materials inserted. Please insert ballistic plates before wearing. ‖color:gui.red‖(No Protection Level)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_carrier_arm: A pair of arm plate carriers without ballistic materials inserted. Please insert ballistic plates before wearing. ‖color:gui.red‖(No Protection Level)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_carrier_gro: A groin plate carrier without ballistic materials inserted. Please insert ballistic plates before wearing. ‖color:gui.red‖(No Protection Level)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_carrier_woo: Marketed as a high-performance ballistic plate, it feels a bit light, but the material inside is definitely not high-polymer. "Which bastard clown provided these plates! The ballistic material inside is damp wood!" ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_metal_3: Metal plate using aluminum as the primary defense. Aluminum is relatively soft and has a lower protection level, capable of defending against low-penetration small-caliber bullets. ‖color:gui.red‖(Metal plates never break, but are heavy)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 1.0)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ (-15% Movement Speed, -15 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_metal_4: Metal plate using iron as the primary defense. Higher protection level than aluminum plates, but also heavier. ‖color:gui.red‖(Metal plates never break, but are heavy)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 1.0)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ (-20% Movement Speed, -20 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_metal_5: Metal plate using light steel as the primary defense. In the pursuit of protection levels, sacrificing mobility is inevitable. ‖color:gui.red‖(Metal plates never break, but are heavy)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 5)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 1.0)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ (-25% Movement Speed, -25 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_metal_6: Double-layer metal plate using Grade 45 steel as the primary defense. Reaches Protection Level 6, but sacrifices significant ergonomics. ‖color:gui.red‖(Metal plates never break, but are heavy)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 1.0)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ (-30% Movement Speed, -30 Weapon Handling)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_plate_metal_7: Double-layer metal plate using composite steel as the primary defense. "With our current technology, we can only improve ballistic protection by adding more material.
