infotexts.entitydescription.deep_balance_contract_: "Whether you choose to accept or not, the decision is yours. I will contact you again at the next outpost." ‖color:gui.green‖Ready? Let the battle begin!‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Use with Right-click + Left-click‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"Deep Diving Armory wants to assess your mid-range combat capabilities. What tactics will you employ without high-magnification scopes?" ‖color:gui.red‖Use of scopes ≥6x magnification is prohibited‖end‖ (Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Standard Supply Crate) ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"Sniper rifles can easily pick off enemies or kill them through walls. Care to challenge yourself without sniper rifles?" ‖color:gui.red‖Use of sniper rifles is prohibited‖end‖ (Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Standard Supply Crate) ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"Shotguns are the weapon of choice for close-quarters combat, clearing enemies as effectively as a trench broom. But now I want to see your true close-range fighting ability." ‖color:gui.red‖Use of shotguns is prohibited‖end‖ (Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Standard Supply Crate) ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"Machine guns have powerful suppressive fire capabilities and dominate the battlefield. Sign this contract, and I'll take care of your old friend for this round." ‖color:gui.red‖Use of machine guns is prohibited‖end‖ (Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Standard Supply Crate) ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"Grenade launchers have strong suppressive power when dealing with swarms or single enemies. However, you can't bring this big guy on this mission." ‖color:gui.red‖Use of grenade launchers is prohibited‖end‖ (Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Standard Supply Crate) ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"The power of Tungsten Physicorium ammo needs no introduction. The Coalition and Separatists are constantly fighting over tungsten resources. Let's just say this operation is to conserve some of it." ‖color:gui.red‖Use of ammunition with ≥9 penetration is prohibited (Deep Diving Armory mod only)‖end‖ (Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Standard Supply Crate) ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"Grenades, C4, and other explosives are deadly weapons in the hands of a veteran. I know it's tough, but people like to challenge themselves, don't they?" ‖color:gui.red‖Use of explosives is prohibited‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Exquisite Supply Crate)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"A high-mobility loadout can always strike enemies by surprise, unlike slow-moving heavy armor." ‖color:gui.red‖Use of metal torso plates is prohibited, and equipped plates cannot exceed level 8‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Exquisite Supply Crate)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"Medkits? Don't need 'em. I'll be right back!" ‖color:gui.red‖+20% Max Health, immune to Bleeding, but -90% healing effectiveness from medical items‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Exquisite Supply Crate)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"In indoor CQB, victory and defeat are often decided in an instant." ‖color:gui.red‖Only 1x magnification sights are allowed‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Exquisite Supply Crate)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"The flames of war destroyed him, and also reborn him. Can you achieve the same level of mastery as the veteran leaders?" ‖color:gui.red‖No friendly deaths are allowed. If any friendly dies, the entire team dies and the round restarts. This effect lasts for the current round.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Rare Supply Crate)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"There was once a security officer who solo-cleared the Ghost Squad with just an M1891 Mosin-Nagant and no grenades. I find that hard to believe. Why don't you try to prove it?" ‖color:gui.red‖Only steel-tier sniper rifles and steel-tier pistols are allowed‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Rare Supply Crate)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"On 20th century Earth, Blitzkrieg was a strategy of overall coordination, global in scope, and tactically brilliant, flexible, and varied. Remember to always check your time." ‖color:gui.red‖12-minute combat timer. You must start the next round before 12 minutes, or the mission will restart when time is up.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Rare Supply Crate)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Holding in hand for 5s is considered automatic acceptance‖end‖

"Leave no one behind. We're all in the same boat." ‖color:gui.red‖If a friendly dies, the entire team dies. Lasts until the next round.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Rewards 1 Deep Diving Armory Rare Supply Crate)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Activate this contract by holding it and using Right-click + Left-click. Once activated, it cannot be revoked unless the round is restarted.‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_white_keycard: An encrypted keycard usually carried by a leader, used to open the outpost's safe. Unfortunately, this card can only be used once. ‖color:gui.red‖Used to open the outpost safe. Can only be used in the current outpost.‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_saintpredator: Meijiule's exclusive weapon. The word "Salvation" is inscribed on the launcher's paint, its meaning known only to the weapon's first owner. ‖color:gui.red‖"I will entrust this power to you."‖end‖ (Two modes: High-Angle Mode - Warhead splits into multiple projectiles and detonates immediately upon impact; Programmable Mode - Warhead ignores obstacles to reach the cursor's position before splitting) ‖color:gui.red‖(Built-in 3x scope magnification)‖end‖ (Has a massive kill radius, beware of friendly fire.)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_clustermsl_saint: A cluster missile loaded with numerous MIRV incendiary warheads, causing devastating damage over a wide area upon detonation. Though it cannot light up the sky, it can tear a dazzling rift in Europa's oppressive darkness. ‖color:gui.red‖“Whether it's this cold and noisy world, or myself... no matter how hard it rains, it can never be washed clean.”‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_APS: A portable active protection system that can destroy low-velocity explosives before they hit their target. ‖color:gui.green‖Interception Range: 3m‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Interceptible Velocity Range: 5-30‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Interception Chance: 95%‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Active Duration: 5s‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Interception Cooldown: 15s‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_safetypin: A safety pin for anti-armor weapons. Pull it out to allow firing, or insert it back to secure.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m72a6: The M72A6 is a man-portable, disposable light anti-armor weapon, firing a 66mm multi-purpose high-explosive anti-tank round. It is cheap to produce; the only thing to watch out for is not roasting your teammates with its backblast. ‖color:gui.red‖Fatal Backblast: Do not stand behind the operator before firing.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Warning: Do not use this behemoth without seasoned weapon handling experience. Consequences are your own.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Pull out the safety pin to fire. Dispose of after use.‖end‖ Fires: 66mm High-Explosive Dual-Purpose (HEDP) rocket (Warhead penetration: 2 layers) (Warhead can penetrate doors or walls before exploding) (-20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_rpg22: The RPG-22 is an individual anti-tank weapon featuring a telescoping tube structure. The outer tube is made of Kevlar, and the inner tube is a fiberglass component. It fires the PG-22 72.5mm shaped-charge HEAT rocket with up to 400mm of armor penetration. High-temperature backblast is produced during firing; do not stand behind the operator. ‖color:gui.red‖Fatal Backblast: Do not stand behind the operator before firing.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Warning: Do not use this behemoth without seasoned weapon handling experience. Consequences are your own.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖Pull out the safety pin to fire. Dispose of after use.‖end‖ Fires: 72.5mm High-Explosive Anti-Tank (HEAT) rocket (Warhead penetration: 3 layers, Armor Penetration: 1.0) (Warhead can penetrate doors or walls before exploding) (-25% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_rpg7: A classic rocket launcher, the RPG-7 is a shoulder-fired, muzzle-loading anti-tank and anti-personnel weapon. It can fire a variety of ammunition types, including tandem-charge HEAT, 40mm fragmentation grenades, and 105mm thermobaric rockets. High-temperature backblast is produced during firing; do not stand behind the operator. ‖color:gui.red‖Fatal Backblast: Do not stand behind the operator before firing.‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖Warning: Do not use this behemoth without seasoned weapon handling experience. Consequences are your own.‖end‖ Fires: PG-7VM, PG-7VR, TBG-7V, OG-7V (-20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_rpg7_pg7vm: The PG-7VM is a 70mm diameter HEAT rocket used by the RPG-7, with a warhead capable of penetrating 300mm of RHA. Fires: 70mm High-Explosive Anti-Tank (HEAT) rocket (Warhead penetration: 3 layers, Armor Penetration: 1.0) (Warhead can penetrate doors or walls before exploding) (-20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_rpg7_pg7vr: The PG-7VR is a tandem HEAT rocket used by the RPG-7. The precursor warhead (64mm HEAT) is designed to detonate explosive reactive armor (ERA) in advance, and the main warhead (105mm HEAT) strikes the underlying physical armor, capable of penetrating 750mm of homogeneous steel armor, or 600mm of RHA after ERA. Fires: 64/105mm Tandem High-Explosive Anti-Tank (HEAT) rocket (Warhead penetration: 5 layers, Armor Penetration: 1.0) (Warhead can penetrate doors or walls before exploding) (-30% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_rpg7_tbg7v: The TBG-7V is a 105mm diameter thermobaric rocket used by the RPG-7, designed for anti-personnel and urban warfare, dealing devastating damage to infantry. Fires: 105mm Thermobaric (TB) rocket ‖color:gui.red‖The explosion of a thermobaric bomb ignores cover and walls, possessing terrifying lethality. Please ensure a safe distance when launching‖end‖ (Explodes instantly upon impact) (-25% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_rpg7_og7v: The OG-7V is a 40mm fragmentation rocket used by the RPG-7. The warhead deals wide-area fragmentation and blast effects, colloquially dubbed the "Pencil" by Separatist soldiers. Fires: 40mm High-Explosive Fragmentation (HE) rocket (Explodes instantly upon impact) (-5% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_refresh_tool: A tool for refreshing items after an update. D o n ' t m i s t a k e i t f o r a t r a s h c a n.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.deep_missing_Lua: Deep Diving Armory depends on Lua and CS to run. You clearly need to install local Lua and launch the game using the Lua executable. If you simply dragged the Lua mod into the mod list on the left and enabled it, that is incorrect. Please find an installation tutorial video on the Workshop page or Bilibili.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_dining_table: A dining table made of steel bars. Flip it on its side to block bullets.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_dining_table_cove: A dining table made of steel bars. Flip it on its side to block bullets.
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_separatist_confid: Contains confidential military intelligence of the Separatist organization. It's best not to open it. "Sometimes, the less you know, the better. We just need to hand it over to the Coalition."
infotexts.missiondescription.deep_meet_on_the_batt: ‖color:gui.red‖To Modders: If you want to fix the generation bug with wrecktags and beacontags, check out the Wrecktags And Beacontags Bug Fix mod.‖end‖ "Our advance team has discovered a Separatist military outpost. Eliminate the enemies inside and seize their confidential documents. The Coalition will not be stingy with your reward. We await good news." ‖color:gui.red‖(The confidential documents are in a safe, which requires an enemy's encrypted card.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_meet_on_the_battl: ‖color:gui.red‖Due to softshell turtle's spaghetti code, accepting this mission (regardless of whether it is checked, as long as the mission exists) will force the "Armed Conflict" outpost to spawn on the map.‖end‖ Thus, the Great Cleansing!
infotexts.missionmessage.deep_meet_on_the_battlegr: Confidential intel acquired. Bring it back to the submarine.
infotexts.missionmessage0.deep_meet_on_the_battleg: Deliver the intel to the next destination.
infotexts.missionsuccess.deep_meet_on_the_battlegr: "Well done. Your actions will bring a bright future to Europa. By the way, you didn't open it, did you... Good."
infotexts.missionfailure.deep_meet_on_the_battlegr: "Captain, are we abandoning the intel?" "I don't like dealing with the Coalition. They're all just empty words."
infotexts.eventtext.deep_meet_on_the_battleground_: "Objective for this operation: Separatist confidential documents." "The Separatists intend to conduct frequent military operations in this area. We need to intercept their military intelligence. Breach the enemy outpost and search for the intel!"
"The Coalition dogs have stolen our military secrets! Stop those bastards!"
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_tac_mask: Want to look tactical and conceal your identity? This balaclava is perfect for you! (Provides basic ID card recognition)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_jacquard_headscar: On Europa, leaving no name when doing bad deeds is a basic quality of a bandit. They all wear headscarves like this one. (Provides basic ID card recognition)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_half_face_towel: Wearing this makes you look a bit like a convenience store robber... Hopefully, the outpost security won't mind. (Provides basic ID card recognition)
infotexts.entityname.deep_rifle_upgrade_tool: Deep Diving Rifle Firepower Upgrade Kit
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_rifle_upgrade_too: An upgrade kit suitable for rifles. It fully modifies Steel and Titanium rifles, pushing their firepower to the limit, ensuring your old friend remains battle-ready. ‖color:gui.red‖(Suitable for Steel and Titanium rifles. Upgrades to Masterwork quality, -50% Spread, +30% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_smg_upgrade_tool: Deep Diving SMG Firepower Upgrade Kit
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_smg_upgrade_tool: An upgrade kit suitable for submachine guns. It fully modifies Steel and Titanium SMGs, pushing their firepower to the limit, ensuring your old friend remains battle-ready. ‖color:gui.red‖(Suitable for Steel and Titanium SMGs. Upgrades to Masterwork quality, -50% Spread, +30% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_pistol_upgrade_tool: Deep Diving Pistol Firepower Upgrade Kit
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_pistol_upgrade_to: An upgrade kit suitable for pistols. It fully modifies Steel and Titanium pistols, pushing their firepower to the limit, ensuring your old friend remains battle-ready. ‖color:gui.red‖(Suitable for Steel and Titanium pistols. Upgrades to Masterwork quality, -50% Spread, +30% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_sniper_upgrade_tool: Deep Diving Sniper Firepower Upgrade Kit
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sniper_upgrade_to: An upgrade kit suitable for sniper rifles. It fully modifies Steel and Titanium sniper rifles, pushing their firepower to the limit, ensuring your old friend remains battle-ready. ‖color:gui.red‖(Suitable for Steel and Titanium sniper rifles. Upgrades to Masterwork quality, -50% Spread, +30% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_shotgun_upgrade_tool: Deep Diving Shotgun Firepower Upgrade Kit
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_shotgun_upgrade_t: An upgrade kit suitable for shotguns. It fully modifies Steel and Titanium shotguns, pushing their firepower to the limit, ensuring your old friend remains battle-ready. ‖color:gui.red‖(Suitable for Steel and Titanium shotguns. Upgrades to Masterwork quality, +30% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_machinegun_upgrade_tool: Deep Diving Machine Gun Firepower Upgrade Kit
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_machinegun_upgrad: An upgrade kit suitable for machine guns. It fully modifies Steel and Titanium machine guns, pushing their firepower to the limit, ensuring your old friend remains battle-ready. ‖color:gui.red‖(Suitable for Steel and Titanium machine guns. Upgrades to Masterwork quality, -50% Spread, +30% Damage, +10% Rate of Fire)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_gl_upgrade_tool: Deep Diving Grenade Launcher Firepower Upgrade Kit
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_gl_upgrade_tool: An upgrade kit suitable for grenade launchers. It fully modifies Steel and Titanium grenade launchers, pushing their firepower to the limit, ensuring your old friend remains battle-ready. ‖color:gui.red‖(Suitable for Steel and Titanium grenade launchers. Upgrades to Masterwork quality, +30% Damage)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_tun_phy_upgrade_tool: Deep Diving Tungsten Physicorium Weapon Upgrade Kit
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_tun_phy_upgrade_t: An upgrade kit suitable for Tungsten Physicorium weapons. It perfectly upgrades Tungsten Physicorium weapons without damaging any details. ‖color:gui.red‖(Suitable for Tungsten Physicorium weapons. Upgrades to Masterwork quality after modification)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_9a91: The 9A-91 assault rifle fires 9x39mm ammunition. It features a gas-operated action and rotating bolt locking system, with a stamped metal receiver to reduce production costs. Its short and compact frame is favored by station police officers, as it can be carried around easily. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 60) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 6, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 750 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ots12: The OTs-12 is modeled after the AKS-74U carbine, so its structure and operation are basically the same. The main difference is the use of 9x39mm ammunition, along with an improved firing mechanism and muzzle compensator. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 70) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1.1, Rate of Fire: 700 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_asval: The "Val" assault rifle uses a gas-operated automatic action and a dual-chamber suppression structure. It fires 9x39mm special subsonic rifle ammunition and features an integrated suppressor. Its extremely high rate of fire combined with 9x39mm special subsonic ammunition delivers devastating blows to enemies at close range. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 80) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Stealth Shot while crouching: +20% Lethal Headshot damage, +10% Gunshot Wound)‖end‖ (-80% Noise Range, -20% Spread) (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 900 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_sr3m: The SR-3M is modeled after the AS suppressed assault rifle and the VSS suppressed sniper rifle. Its overall length is comparable to an SMG. Firing 9x39mm special rifle ammunition, it combines the mobility of an SMG with the power of a rifle round. Highly favored by Separatist assault troopers. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 100) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 4, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 950 RPM, +15% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entityname.deep_asvalmod4: AS VAL MOD.4 "Val" Suppressed Assault Rifle
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_asvalmod4: The ultimate modification of the AS VAL "Val" assault rifle. The Separatist research institute solved the Val's overheating issue, installing standard Picatinny rails and a more ergonomic stock. "Unfortunately, this rifle is extremely rare. I've dealt with the Separatists many times but have never seen it." — Deep Diving Armory PigCat Senpai ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 130) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Stealth Shot while crouching: +20% Lethal Headshot damage, +10% Gunshot Wound)‖end‖ (-80% Noise Range, -20% Spread) (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1.1, Rate of Fire: 900 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ots14: Rat Snake's exclusive weapon. The OTs-14 "Groza" is not just an assault rifle, but the name of an integrated weapon system combining an assault rifle and a grenade launcher, designed to be quickly converted in the field. Fires 9x39mm rounds and can be equipped with an underbarrel grenade launcher. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon: Full Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ (Reload: 1.5s, Spread: 3, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 800 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_vss: The VSS "Vintorez" is primarily issued to special forces and law enforcement units for covert operations. It uses 9x39mm ammunition and features an integrated suppressor to minimize firing noise, with an automatic fire mode for emergencies. This rifle still serves within the Separatist forces, mainly issued to infiltration units. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +50% Lethal Headshot, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 100) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Stealth Shot while crouching: +20% Lethal Headshot damage, +10% Gunshot Wound)‖end‖ (-80% Noise Range, -20% Spread) (Reload: 2s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 800 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_vsk94: The VSK-94 employs a gas-operated action and a rotating bolt, equipped with a detachable suppressor. Its 9x39mm subsonic ammunition allows for silent shooting within 50 meters to precisely eliminate targets, with a full-auto selector. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Full Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +50% Lethal Headshot, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 120) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Stealth Shot while crouching: +20% Lethal Headshot damage, +10% Gunshot Wound)‖end‖ (-80% Noise Range, -20% Spread) (Reload: 2s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1, Rate of Fire: 850 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_9a91_mag_lead: Contains 20 rounds of 9x39mm subsonic ammunition. High damage falloff over distance, but extremely high damage at close range. (Armor Penetration: 0.4) ‖color:gui.orange‖(Significant damage falloff when attacking distant targets)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 4‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 2.5)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Lead Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_9a91_mag_tit: Contains 20 rounds of 9x39mm subsonic Titanium ammunition. High damage falloff over distance, but extremely high damage at close range. (Armor Penetration: 0.6) ‖color:gui.orange‖(Significant damage falloff when attacking distant targets)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 6‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 2.5)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Titanium Reloading Box.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_9a91_mag_du: Contains 20 rounds of 9x39mm subsonic depleted uranium ammunition. High damage falloff over distance, but extremely high damage at close range. (Armor Penetration: 0.6) ‖color:gui.orange‖(Significant damage falloff when attacking distant targets)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Penetration Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Can penetrate Protection Level 6‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can penetrate friendly targets, cannot deal damage to friendlies)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Hit creatures suffer -30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Headshot Multiplier: 200%)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot: 2.5)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Reload using Deep Diving Armory Ammo Loader, requires Depleted Uranium Reloading Box.)‖end‖

infotexts.entitydescription.deep_xingji_suit: Shadow Moon Azure Wolf's cosplay outfit. ‖color:gui.blue‖Originating from Terra of a different timeline, holding the battle line with the power of the stars. infotexts.entitydescription.deep_yangtuo_suit: A custom ballistic bodysuit worn by Subject "#29410", excavated along with Subject "#29410" from an abandoned site of the "Eye of Europa". Its reconstruction technology has been destroyed with the site. Under normal state, this suit maintains a nylon-spandex blend fabric structure; in combat state, the neck device can change the material via electrical frequency, reinforcing the clothing's protection rating. This clothing is a replica suit, so unfortunately, it does not possess any protection rating. ‖color:gui.blue‖(Beautification Pack: Europa Moe Project)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(This clothing will not overwrite vanilla textures, will cause eye sores.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_yangtuo_hat: An identification tag pocketed by Subject "#29410" on her way back, rescued by Deep Diving company personnel. After hearing stories about distant Earth from the site staff, she decided to personally engrave her favorite animal on it as her callsign. ‖color:gui.blue‖(Beautification Pack: Europa Moe Project)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(This clothing can overwrite vanilla textures, will not cause eye sores.)‖end‖
infotexts.entityname.deep_m2_ammobox_hefc: M2 Heavy Machine Gun Ammo Box (HEFC)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_m2_ammobox_hefc: Armor-piercing explosive ammunition for the M2 HMG. Bullets will detonate inside after penetrating target armor, inflicting explosive trauma. (Ammo Count: 150, very suitable for dealing with elite targets)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_LYXN: Heyuanmu's exclusive weapon, equipped with an underbarrel shotgun. A fully automatic rifle fitted with full tactical attachments. An indispensable choice for breaching and assault combat. ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode, press F to switch Underbarrel Weapon: Full Auto, Semi)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖(Semi-Auto: +30% Damage, -70% Spread)‖end‖ ‖color:0,200,255,255‖(Overheat Durability: 140) Will not overheat underwater‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖(Stealth Shot while crouching: +20% Lethal Headshot damage, +10% Gunshot Wound)‖end‖ (-80% Noise Range, -20% Spread) (Includes built-in red dot sight benefits) (Reload: 1.6s, Spread: 2, Damage Multiplier: 1.2, Rate of Fire: 750 RPM)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_izanagi_paidaxing: Patrick Star's exclusive weapon. "Shame, guilt, fear. We carry them all. Gather your regrets, and wipe out as many as you can. Let the enemy feel the weight of your burden." — Ada-1 ‖color:gui.green‖(Press V to switch Fire Mode: Semi, 4-Round Burst)‖end‖ (Reload: 2s, Spread: 1, Damage Multiplier: 1.0, Rate of Fire: 0.15)

infotexts.entitydescription.latte_map_information: ‖color:gui.green‖A standard modular city, which Europans call 'Latte' City to commemorate its designer, Taylor Wright.‖end‖ "The central hall of Latte City extends in all directions, so launching an assault from there is not recommended. The upper reactor area connects the east and west sniper corridors. The fire escape serves as our main point of entry, but watch out as enemies can also patrol there. A temporary aquatic entry point has been set up to the west, allowing an assault from the west bedroom area. A long ladder is available to the east, facilitating operations toward the east bedroom and the reactor. Commander, lead your squad to attack from multiple directions, establish crossfire, and encircle the enemy!" ‖color:gui.red‖Map Size: Large‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖Recommended Weapons: Rifles, Sniper Rifles‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Additional Support: Medical Beds‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.frozen_armory_map_info: ‖color:gui.green‖We have discovered this secret base inside a frozen cavern. This base is well-concealed, and the enemy has gathered a massive force here, likely planning to strike nearby outposts.‖end‖ "A relatively small troop staging area. The temperature is extremely low, and normal divers would not venture into such freezing waters, which allowed the enemy to grow unchecked. The interior of the Frozen Armory is intricate, meaning engagements will occur at close ranges. Fighting here will inevitably result in close-quarters combat. We have set up two temporary entry points to grant the Commander a better tactical advantage. The left tunnel leads to the third-floor entry point, allowing a direct attack on the enemy's core position. The right aquatic route leads to the first floor's right side, allowing you to sweep the hostiles on the ground floor. Exercise extreme caution when operating in such confined spaces. We await your good news, Commander!" ‖color:gui.red‖Map Size: Small‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖Recommended Weapons: SMGs, Shotguns, Grenades‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Additional Support: Medical Beds‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.mining_map_information: ‖color:gui.green‖Since its establishment, the 'Aylesbury' Mining Center has been primarily responsible for extracting abyssal minerals. This massive mining company integrates mining, smelting, sales, and a complete industrial chain. Unfortunately, the once-prosperous center has been dragged into the mud of war, turning into a battlefield contested by the Coalition and Separatist forces. Whoever controls the mineral resources holds the dominant hand in the war.‖end‖ "The overall layout of the Mining Center is straightforward. Fortunately, its designer was a veteran architect who laid out the rooms logically. I have marked 3 assault entry points: the main lobby, the left airlock, and the right airlock. At the far west and far east of the mining center, mineral lifts are available; use them wisely to covertly reach the upper levels. The upper level features an exceptionally long corridor, perfect for exploiting the range advantages of sniper rifles. Move out, Commander!" ‖color:gui.red‖Map Size: Large‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖Recommended Weapons: Rifles, Sniper Rifles‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Additional Support: Medical Beds‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.ship_map_information: ‖color:gui.green‖The 'New Iapetus' Supersteel Shipyard, a veteran shipbuilder of Europa. The Winter-class submarines were built here. Today, the old shipyard lies abandoned, serving as a covert stronghold packed with massive military supplies, and even housing an unfinished Dugong-class submarine.‖end‖ "The abandoned shipyard did not look like this initially; it grew into its complex layout after multiple temporary reinforcements by the enemy. Ruins, aged hatches, and makeshift blockades make the terrain highly convoluted. Penetrating the enemy's nest without knowing the layout would be suicide. According to reliable intel, the shipyard is divided into two large chambers, East and West. The spaces are broad, but as you move to the upper levels, sightlines shorten and space tightens; keep a constant eye on your rear when advancing. Stay alert, Commander, this is bound to be a brutal engagement!" ‖color:gui.red‖Map Size: Large‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖Recommended Weapons: Rifles, Sniper Rifles, Shotguns‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Additional Support: Medical Beds‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.farport_map_informatio: ‖color:gui.red‖Test Map: You may encounter illogical designs or bugs, feedback at the group is welcome!‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖"As a prestigious integrated construction facility, Farport has been a crucial industrial hub since its completion. Until the flames of war spread here, the factory's production lines worked overtime to supply weapons and ammo to the front. Today, Farport is occupied, and its production lines have fallen into enemy hands. Retake the construction facility, and cut off the enemy's supply source!"‖end‖ "Over the years, the Farport Construction Yard has undergone multiple reconstructions. The massive internal structure has grown highly complex due to frequent modifications. The overall layout is split by a central vertical shaft into three sections: the two-story industrial production sector on the left, the two submarine construction dry docks on the right, and the open-air rooftop terrace area at the top. Having suffered less damage from combat, Farport's structure is relatively intact, with significantly fewer covers than other engagement zones. Fortunately, a maintenance corridor lies beneath the dry docks for stealthy infiltration, and the industrial production sector offers overhead gantry beams to climb and overseer platforms that overlook the production lines. A control room overlooking the entire production area is also located on the open terrace. Utilizing the terrain and long-range sniper weapons to strike from unexpected angles may be key to victory. Aside from entering directly through the central shaft, we have discovered an abandoned maintenance shaft leading to a communications tower next to the facility's outer wall. Daring soldiers can climb the escape ladders to scale the wall and enter the terrace area. This allows seizing the control center to aid team assaults or sniping enemies from high ground. But beware: the twenty-meter-high outer wall has no safety measures; a single slip means falling to your doom." The battle at Farport will undoubtedly be a duel between snipers. With the Commander's skill, victory is assured! ‖color:gui.red‖Map Size: Extremely Large‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖Recommended Weapons: Rifles, Sniper Rifles, Shields‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Additional Support: Surveillance Cameras‖end‖

infotexts.entityname.gen4_protection: Gen4 Heavy Plate Carrier Vest (Full Protection)
infotexts.entitydescription.gen4_protection: Coalition's fourth-generation plate carrier vest. Modular and fully scalable, the GEN4 can easily be modified for enhanced protection. This Full Protection version allows adding extra arm and groin plates for complete protection, at the cost of increased weight causing reduced mobility. ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms, Thighs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 3)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.05)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Additional Support: Arm Plates, Groin Plate)‖end‖ (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-30% Movement Speed)

infotexts.entityname.deep_thor_protection: THOR Full Protection Plate Carrier Vest
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_thor_protection: The latest full protection body armor released by the Coalition Defense Research Institute. Although the Coalition military does not focus on heavy equipment R&D, they are forced to use ultra-heavy armor for breakthrough operations in extremely high-pressure missions. The THOR Full Protection was born; this body armor is issued in small numbers within the Coalition forces, reserved only for extremely high-risk operations. ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Area: Torso, Arms, Thighs)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lining Protection Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Blunt Trauma Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Additional Support: Arm Plates, Groin Plate)‖end‖ (Can install different plates for corresponding protection) (-30% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_tactical_visor: The Coalition military's favorite tactical visor. Wearing it makes you feel capable of stopping a submarine. (Provides basic ID card recognition)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_ump45_suit: Absinthe's personal outfit, a UMP45 attire featuring powerful protective capabilities. ‖color:gui.blue‖(Beautification Pack: Europa Moe Project)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(This clothing can overwrite vanilla textures, will not cause eye sores.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_suomi_suit: Tactical Doll Suomi. "She will bravely set off for her companions in the community, and wander to find her cherished ones. Entrust your mission to this cheerful girl with peace of mind." "She will be very happy if you share exciting rock music with her." ‖color:gui.blue‖(Beautification Pack: Europa Moe Project)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(This clothing can overwrite vanilla textures, will not cause eye sores.)‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.typhoon_map_informatio: ‖color:gui.green‖Typhoon-class mobile cities often come under attack; various factions will try every means to intercept and capture the Typhoon.‖end‖ "The garrison defending the Typhoon held out until the last moment. Currently, multiple defensive fortifications have been set up inside the Typhoon. The dormitory area has complex terrain. Boarding actions are recommended, or capture the engineering area first. The front section of the Typhoon has many corridors, suitable for sniper operations. Flexibly choose attack points, break through the marked destructible walls, and launch surprise attacks on the enemy. I believe we can definitely retake the Typhoon!" ‖color:gui.red‖Map Size: Large‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖Recommended Weapons: Shotgun, Rifle, Sniper Rifle‖end‖ ‖color:gui.green‖Additional Aid: Medical Bed, Destructible Walls‖end‖
infotexts.eventtext.quick_move: "Need a lift? I can take you quickly to the assault point."
infotexts.eventtext.quick_move_contract_room: Quick travel to the Contract Room?
infotexts.eventtext.quick_move2: "These are the currently selected efficient assault points, which can catch the enemy off guard."
infotexts.eventtext.quick_move_no: "Thanks, but I think I'll stick to the conventional approach."
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_helmet_ranger: The basic protection kit model of the FAST helmet. The FAST "Ranger" adds eye protection and ear cover kits, allowing soldiers to mount tactical equipment. ‖color:gui.green‖(40% chance of ricochet, head takes no damage)‖end‖‖color:gui.red‖Overmatched by bullets with ≥6 penetration, ricochet chance ignored‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 4)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Neural Adjustment upgrades)‖end‖ (-10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_helmet_striker: Based on the FAST helmet with an additional ballistic helmet layer + Level 3A heavy face shield and ear protection kit. The FAST "Striker" heavy helmet protects you from shrapnel attacks in heavy firefights, making it the top choice for Coalition Heavy Defenders. ‖color:gui.green‖(50% chance of ricochet, head takes no damage)‖end‖‖color:gui.red‖Overmatched by bullets with ≥8 penetration, ricochet chance ignored‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 6)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Neural Adjustment upgrades)‖end‖ (-10% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_helmet_heavy_troo: Installs a "Heavy Trooper" ballistic visor and compact ear covers on the FAST helmet. The visor includes an aluminum alloy mount compatible with tactical equipment, supporting night vision goggles, thermal imagers, and more. "The Coalition Defense Research Institute's latest generation lightweight ballistic visor not only allows headset configuration but also supports various equipment. The only flaw? Well, production cost is still rather high..." — Coalition Veteran Leader ‖color:gui.green‖(40% chance of ricochet, head takes no damage)‖end‖‖color:gui.red‖Overmatched by bullets with ≥7 penetration, ricochet chance ignored‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 5)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Neural Adjustment upgrades)‖end‖ (-5% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_helmet_sledge_ham: The 4th generation FAST all-environment combat helmet system, crafted using state-of-the-art composite materials. The standard version features a "Sledge Hammer" deformation-resistant ballistic visor and a titanium mount for camera recording equipment. Combining mobility with protection, it provides Coalition Special Forces with the most advanced combat helmet. "A heavy helmet built with the Coalition's most high-end technology. Frankly, I'd still rather wear my old pal Altyn. Don't get me wrong, I'm not belittling this helmet. It's just that the bullet dents on my old friend prove his worth." — Grizzly "Legendary Captain" ‖color:gui.green‖(60% chance of ricochet, head takes no damage)‖end‖‖color:gui.red‖Overmatched by bullets with ≥9 penetration, ricochet chance ignored‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Protection Level: 7)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Higher is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Post-Penetration Damage Multiplier: 0.8)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Lethal Headshot Multiplier (Non-Penetrating): 0.1)‖end‖‖color:gui.green‖Lower is better‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(Can install Neural Adjustment upgrades)‖end‖ (-20% Movement Speed)
infotexts.entitydescription.deep_mark_suit_knight: The half‑covered design combines wildness and restraint, interweaving strength with flirtatious charm, cold and stunning yet extremely aggressive. ‖color:gui.blue‖(Texture provided by: Mark)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.blue‖(Beautification Pack: Europa Moe Project)‖end‖ ‖color:gui.red‖(This clothing can overwrite vanilla textures, will not cause eye sores.)‖end‖
